    def begin_bootstrap_application_plan(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> None:
        """Start the application terminal without replaying interrogation steps."""
        if self._schema_plan is None:
            msg = "bootstrap interrogation plan must exist before application planning"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        generation = self._schema_plan_generation
        self._schema_plan_generation += 1
        self._schema_operation_plan = SchemaOperationPlan()
        self._schema_plan_builder = _schema_plan_generation_for_planning(generation)
        self._schema_plan = _base_server_plan_module().BaseServerPlan(
            self,
            session_id=self._session_id,
            backend_profile=self.backend_profile,
            semantic_plan_builder=self._schema_plan_builder,

    def complete_bootstrap_application_plan(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        *,
        transaction_committed: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        """Retire an application request after successful plan materialization."""
        if self._schema_plan is None:
            msg = "bootstrap application plan must exist before completion"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        receipt = self._bootstrap_generation_receipt
        if self._bootstrap_generation_receipt_tags and receipt is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Bootstrap application completed without a schema generation receipt")
        self._last_schema_ddl_ref_id = None
        self._bootstrap_application_transaction_completed = transaction_committed
        self._precomputed_schema_generation_bumps = receipt if receipt is not None else SchemaGenerationBumps()
        self._schema_plan = None
        publish_bootstrap_hash_helpers_installed(self._conn)

    @pure_lazy
    def bootstrap_projected_columns(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
    ) -> frozenset[SqlColumnName] | NoColumnSnapshot:
        """Return closed projected columns without consulting runtime metadata."""
        normalized_table_name = SqlTableName(table_name)
        if self.bulk_physical_table_exists(normalized_table_name) is not SchemaFactPresence.ABSENT:
            proof_columns = self._bootstrap_column_proof_snapshot(normalized_table_name)
            if type(proof_columns) is not NoColumnSnapshot:
                return frozenset(SqlColumnName(column_name) for column_name in proof_columns)
            observed_columns = self._schema_reconciliation_column_snapshot(
                normalized_table_name,
            )
            if type(observed_columns) is not NoColumnSnapshot:
                return frozenset(SqlColumnName(column_name) for column_name in observed_columns)
        plan = next(
            (
                operation.bootstrap_ddl_plan
                for operation in reversed(self._schema_operation_plan.operations)
                if operation.kind is SchemaOperationKind.BOOTSTRAP_PROJECTION and operation.bootstrap_ddl_plan is not UNSET
            ),
            None,
        )
        if plan is None:
            from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_physical_contract import physical_schema_contract_for_model

            for model_cls in get_registered_tables():
                contract = physical_schema_contract_for_model(model_cls)
                declared_columns = contract.required_columns_by_table.get(normalized_table_name)
                if declared_columns is not None:
                    return frozenset(SqlColumnName(column_name) for column_name in declared_columns)
            return NoColumnSnapshot()
        owns_table = any(normalized_table_name in table_fact.family_tables for table_fact in plan.table_family_facts)
        columns = frozenset(fact.column_name for fact in plan.column_facts if fact.table_name == normalized_table_name)
        if not owns_table and not columns:
            return NoColumnSnapshot()
        return columns

    def projected_schema_ddl_artifact_exists(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        ddl_sql: SqlRenderable,
        *,
        phase: SchemaDdlPhase | DefaultSchemaDdlPhase = DefaultSchemaDdlPhase(),
    ) -> bool:
        """Return whether a deterministic DDL artifact is already projected."""
        artifact = _schema_artifact_fact(ddl_sql, phase=phase)
        match artifact:
            case NoSchemaArtifactFact():
                return False
            case tuple():
                _kind, _table_name, _artifact_name, fingerprint = artifact
        return fingerprint in self._schema_operation_plan.ddl_artifact_fingerprints

    @pure_lazy
    def _claim_bootstrap_ddl_artifact_owner(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        key: BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKey,
        *,
        owner_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        phase: SchemaDdlPhase | DefaultSchemaDdlPhase,
        statement_index: int | Unset = UNSET,
    ) -> BootstrapPhysicalDdlOwner | NoBootstrapPhysicalDdlOwner:
        """Claim a physical artifact key; return the canonical owner for duplicates."""

        fingerprint = _schema_artifact_fingerprint(key, phase=phase)
        if fingerprint in self._schema_operation_plan.ddl_artifact_fingerprints:
            owner = BootstrapPhysicalDdlOwner(
                key=key,
                owner_ref=ServerPlanRefId(owner_ref),
                phase=phase,
                statement_index=statement_index,
            )
            _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("schema_ddl_artifact_deduped"), DiagnosticLabel(key.kind))
            _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("schema_ddl_artifact_deduped"), DiagnosticLabel("total"))
            return owner
        self._project_bootstrap_ddl_artifact_fact(key, phase=phase)
        return NoBootstrapPhysicalDdlOwner()

    @pure_lazy
    def _project_bootstrap_ddl_artifact_fact(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        key: BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKey,
        *,
        phase: SchemaDdlPhase | DefaultSchemaDdlPhase,
    ) -> None:
        """Project schema-plan facts for a claimed physical DDL artifact."""

        fingerprint = _schema_artifact_fingerprint(key, phase=phase)
        if fingerprint in self._schema_operation_plan.ddl_artifact_fingerprints:
            return
        if key.kind is BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind.BACKEND:
            self._schema_operation_plan.add_operation(
                SchemaOperation(
                    kind=SchemaOperationKind.DDL_EFFECT,
                    name=SchemaDdlOperationName(key.object_name),
                    effects=SchemaOperationEffects(
                        ddl_artifact_fingerprints=frozenset({fingerprint}),
                    ),
                ),
            )
            return
        raw_table_name = key.table_name
        if raw_table_name is UNSET:
            return
        table_name = SqlTableName(raw_table_name)
        effects = SchemaOperationEffects(
            touched_tables=frozenset({table_name}),
            existing_tables=(frozenset({table_name}) if key.kind is BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind.TABLE else frozenset()),
            triggers_by_table=(
                {table_name: frozenset({SqlTriggerName(key.object_name)})} if key.kind is BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind.TRIGGER else {}
            ),
            indexes_by_table=(
                {table_name: frozenset({SqlIndexName(key.object_name)})} if key.kind is BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind.INDEX else {}
            ),
            columns_by_table=(
                {table_name: frozenset({SqlColumnName(key.object_name)})} if key.kind is BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind.COLUMN else {}
            ),
            ddl_artifact_fingerprints=frozenset({fingerprint}),
        )
        operation_kind = (
            SchemaOperationKind.CREATE_TABLE
            if key.kind is BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind.TABLE
            else SchemaOperationKind.CREATE_TRIGGER
            if key.kind is BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind.TRIGGER
            else SchemaOperationKind.ADD_COLUMN
            if key.kind is BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKind.COLUMN
            else SchemaOperationKind.CREATE_INDEX
        )
        self._schema_operation_plan.add_operation(
            SchemaOperation(
                kind=operation_kind,
                name=SchemaDdlOperationName(key.object_name),
                effects=effects,
            ),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _dedupe_bootstrap_ddl_bundle(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        statements: tuple[SqlRenderable, ...],
        *,
        source_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...],
        phase: SchemaDdlPhase | DefaultSchemaDdlPhase,
        name: SchemaDdlOperationName | AnonymousSchemaDdlOperation,
    ) -> tuple[tuple[SqlRenderable, ...], tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...]]:
        """Return canonical bundle statements after physical-artifact ownership claims."""

        kept_statements: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        kept_source_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        source_prefix: SchemaDdlOperationName | SchemaDdlPhase | DefaultSchemaDdlPhase
        match name:
            case SchemaDdlOperationName():
                source_prefix = name
            case AnonymousSchemaDdlOperation():
                source_prefix = phase
        for index, statement in enumerate(statements):
            source_ref = source_refs[index] if source_refs else ServerPlanRefId(f"{source_prefix}:{index}")
            key = _schema_artifact_key(statement, phase=phase)
            match key:
                case NoSchemaArtifactKey():
                    kept_statements.append(statement)
                    if source_refs:
                        kept_source_refs.append(source_ref)
                    continue
                case BootstrapPhysicalDdlArtifactKey():
                    pass
            if key.kind == "index" and self._bootstrap_transition_ddl_records is not None:
                kept_statements.append(statement)
                if source_refs:
                    kept_source_refs.append(source_ref)
                continue
            canonical_owner = self._claim_bootstrap_ddl_artifact_owner(
                key,
                owner_ref=ServerPlanRefId(source_ref),
                phase=phase,
                statement_index=index,
            )
            if type(canonical_owner) is not NoBootstrapPhysicalDdlOwner:
                self._schema_operation_plan.add_duplicate_ddl_source_ref(ServerPlanRefId(source_ref))
                continue
            kept_statements.append(statement)
            if source_refs:
                kept_source_refs.append(source_ref)
        return tuple(kept_statements), tuple(kept_source_refs)

    @pure_lazy

    ) -> tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...]:

        Duplicate source identity is carried by typed ``BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan``
        operations and facts; the canonical DDL dependency owns execution.
        """
        del self, source_refs, canonical_dependency_refs
        return ()

    @property
    @external_io_boundary
    def planning_catalog(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> PlanningCatalog:
        """Return the schema transaction's immutable planning metadata snapshot."""
        catalog = self._planning_catalog
        if catalog is None:
            catalog = _build_schema_planning_catalog_runtime(self._conn)
            self._planning_catalog = catalog
        if self._schema_planning_catalog_overlay_enabled and (
            self._schema_operation_plan.catalog_models
            or self._schema_operation_plan.existing_tables
            or self._schema_operation_plan.columns_by_table
        ):
            revision = self._schema_operation_plan.revision
            cache_key = (id(catalog), revision)
            cached_overlay = self._planning_catalog_overlay_cache
            if cached_overlay is not None and cached_overlay[:2] == cache_key:
                return cast("PlanningCatalog", cached_overlay[2])
            overlay = self._build_planning_catalog_overlay(catalog)
            self._planning_catalog_overlay_cache = (cache_key[0], cache_key[1], overlay)
            return cast("PlanningCatalog", overlay)
        return catalog

    @contextmanager
    def _base_planning_catalog_scope(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> Generator[None]:
        """Compile closed schema products against their original catalog snapshot."""
        previous_overlay_enabled = self._schema_planning_catalog_overlay_enabled
        self._schema_planning_catalog_overlay_enabled = False
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            self._schema_planning_catalog_overlay_enabled = previous_overlay_enabled

    def _build_planning_catalog_overlay(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        base_catalog: PlanningCatalog,
    ) -> PlanningCatalogOverlay:
        """Build a transaction-local catalog overlay from projected schema effects."""
        planning_catalog_module = _planning_catalog_module()

        overlay_models = set(self._schema_operation_plan.catalog_models)
        for table_name in self._schema_operation_plan.columns_by_table:
            base_table = base_catalog.tables_by_name.get(table_name)
            if base_table is not None:
                overlay_models.add(base_table.model_cls)

        authoritative_contract = self._conn._authoritative_planning_catalog_contract
        if (
            authoritative_contract is not None
            and self._conn._authoritative_planning_catalog_sealed
            and not self._conn._authoritative_planning_catalog_evolution_allowed
        ):
            authoritative_contract.require_subset(overlay_models)

        revision = self._schema_operation_plan.revision
        for model_cls in tuple(overlay_models):
            if self._catalog_delta_model_revisions.get(model_cls) == revision:
                continue
            table_shape = planning_catalog_module.build_table_shape(model_cls)
            self._catalog_delta_tables[model_cls] = table_shape
            self._catalog_delta_tables_by_name[table_shape.table_name] = table_shape
            self._catalog_delta_models_by_class_name[model_cls.__name__] = model_cls
            self._catalog_delta_write_metadata[model_cls] = planning_catalog_module.build_write_metadata_plan(
                model_cls,
            )
            self._catalog_delta_read_metadata[model_cls] = planning_catalog_module.build_read_metadata_plan(
                model_cls,
            )
            projected_columns = set(table_shape.db_columns.values())
            projected_columns.update(
                self._schema_operation_plan.columns_by_table.get(table_shape.table_name, ()),
            )
            if base_catalog.backend_type is None:
                if planning_catalog_module._catalog_contains_graph_models((model_cls,)):
                    msg = "Graph planning catalog overlays require a backend-scoped base catalog"
                    raise RuntimeError(msg)
                graph_shape = None
            else:
                include_hash32_columns = (
                    base_catalog.backend_type.is_sql_backend
                    and planning_catalog_module.supports_graph_hash32_generated_columns(
                        base_catalog.backend_type,
                    )
                )
                graph_shape = planning_catalog_module.build_graph_access_path_shape(
                    model_cls,
                    include_hash32_columns=include_hash32_columns,
                    access_columns=projected_columns,
                )
            if graph_shape is not None:
                self._catalog_delta_graph_access[model_cls] = graph_shape
                self._catalog_delta_graph_access_by_table[graph_shape.table_name] = graph_shape
            else:
                self._catalog_delta_graph_access.pop(model_cls, None)
                self._catalog_delta_graph_access_by_table.pop(table_shape.table_name, None)
            self._catalog_delta_model_revisions[model_cls] = revision

        delta = planning_catalog_module.CatalogDelta(
            tables=self._catalog_delta_tables,
            tables_by_name=self._catalog_delta_tables_by_name,
            models_by_class_name=self._catalog_delta_models_by_class_name,
            write_metadata=self._catalog_delta_write_metadata,
            read_metadata=self._catalog_delta_read_metadata,
            graph_access=self._catalog_delta_graph_access,
            graph_access_by_table=self._catalog_delta_graph_access_by_table,
            existing_tables=frozenset(self._schema_operation_plan.existing_tables),
            columns_by_table={
                table_name: frozenset(columns) for table_name, columns in self._schema_operation_plan.columns_by_table.items()
            },
            schema_plan_revision=self._schema_operation_plan.revision,
        )
        return PlanningCatalogOverlay(base=base_catalog, delta=delta)

    def _build_bulk_observation_snapshot(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_info_by_name: tuple[tuple[SqlTableName, tuple[TableInfoRow, ...]], ...],
    ) -> "SchemaStateSnapshot":
        """Build one immutable physical snapshot before bulk declaration starts."""
        from l3200_metadata.schema_state_snapshot import (
            SchemaColumnFact,
            SchemaFactSource,
            SchemaStateSnapshot,
            SchemaTableFact,
        )

        table_facts: list[SchemaTableFact] = []
        column_facts: list[SchemaColumnFact] = []
        for table_name, rows in table_info_by_name:
            table_facts.append(
                SchemaTableFact(
                    table_name=table_name,
                    exists=True,
                    source=SchemaFactSource.RECONCILIATION_OBSERVATION,
                ),
            )
            observed_columns: set[str] = set()
            for row in rows:
                raw_name = row.get("name", row.get("column_name"))
                if raw_name is None:
                    continue
                column_name = str(raw_name)
                observed_columns.add(column_name)
                raw_not_null = row.get("notnull")
                raw_nullable = row.get("nullable")
                nullable = (
                    not bool(raw_not_null) if raw_not_null is not None else bool(raw_nullable) if raw_nullable is not None else None
                )
                raw_type = row.get("type", row.get("data_type"))
                raw_default = row.get("dflt_value", row.get("default_value"))
                column_facts.append(
                    SchemaColumnFact(
                        table_name=table_name,
                        column_name=SqlColumnName(column_name),
                        exists=True,
                        source=SchemaFactSource.RECONCILIATION_OBSERVATION,
                        data_type=IntrospectedSqlTypeName(str(raw_type)) if raw_type is not None else None,
                        nullable=nullable,
                        default_value=GeneratedSqlExpressionText(str(raw_default)) if raw_default is not None else None,
                    ),
                )
            self._bulk_column_snapshots[table_name] = frozenset(SqlColumnName(column_name) for column_name in observed_columns)
        return SchemaStateSnapshot(
            table_facts=tuple(table_facts),
            column_facts=tuple(column_facts),
        )

    @contextmanager
    @external_io_boundary
    def _bulk_schema_plan_context(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> Generator[None]:
        """Enable transaction-local caches while a bulk schema plan executes."""
        from l2055_lazy_result.purity import in_lazy_context, intent_build_context_lazy

        outermost = self._bulk_schema_depth == 0
        self._bulk_schema_depth += 1
        should_flush = False
        try:
            if outermost:
                proven_tables = self._proven_existing_table_names_from_connection()
                observed_tables = (
                    proven_tables
                    if proven_tables is not None and type(proven_tables) is not NoTableSnapshot
                    else frozenset(SqlTableName(str(table_name)) for table_name in self._conn._list_tables_under_authority())
                )
                self._bulk_table_names_snapshot = frozenset(SqlTableName(str(table_name)) for table_name in observed_tables)
                table_info_by_name = {
                    SqlTableName(table_name): tuple(
                        self._conn._backend_schema_service.get_table_info(
                            SqlTableName(table_name),
                        ),
                    )
                    for table_name in self._bulk_table_names_snapshot
                }
                self._schema_reconciliation_snapshot = self._build_bulk_observation_snapshot(
                    tuple(table_info_by_name.items()),
                )
            with intent_build_context_lazy():
                yield
            should_flush = True
        finally:
            self._bulk_schema_depth -= 1
            if self._bulk_schema_depth == 0:
                try:
                    if should_flush and not in_lazy_context():
                        with _nera_bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("bulk_schema_context.flush_schema_plan")):
                            self.flush_schema_plan()
                finally:
                    self._bulk_backend_executors.clear()
                    self._bulk_table_names_snapshot = None
                    self._bulk_column_snapshots.clear()
                    self._bulk_index_snapshots.clear()

    @pure_lazy
    def _bulk_schema_mode_active(self: LazySchemaTransaction[ConnT]) -> bool:
        """Return whether schema operations should be enqueued for a bulk flush."""
        return self._bulk_schema_depth > 0

    @contextmanager
    @pure_lazy
    def _schema_table_exists_cache_mutation_scope(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> Generator[None]:
        """Temporarily unseal table-exists cache for schema-transaction DDL."""
        from l2055_lazy_result.purity import in_bootstrap_plan_active_context, in_lazy_context

        conn = self._conn
        was_sealed = conn.is_table_exists_cache_sealed()
        strict_bootstrap_active = in_bootstrap_plan_active_context()
        if was_sealed:
            conn.unseal_table_exists_cache()
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            if was_sealed:
                projected_tables = self._existing_tables_snapshot_for_schema_batch
                if projected_tables is None:
                    bulk_snapshot = self._bulk_table_names_snapshot
                    if bulk_snapshot is not None:
                        projected_tables = set(bulk_snapshot)
                if projected_tables is None:
                    schema_snapshot = self._schema_table_names_snapshot
                    if schema_snapshot is not None:
                        projected_tables = set(schema_snapshot)
                if projected_tables is None:
                    proven_snapshot = self._proven_existing_table_names_from_connection()
                    if proven_snapshot is not None and type(proven_snapshot) is not NoTableSnapshot:
                        projected_tables = set(proven_snapshot)
                if projected_tables is not None:
                    conn._seal_table_exists_cache_from_tables(
                        tuple(SqlTableName(table_name) for table_name in sorted(projected_tables)),
                    )
                elif strict_bootstrap_active:
                    msg = "Strict bootstrap reseal requires a transaction-local table snapshot"
                    raise LazyPurityError(msg)
                else:
                    conn.seal_table_exists_cache()

    def replay_bootstrap_transition_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,

        *,

    ) -> LazyResult[BootstrapTransitionReplayFact | BootstrapTransitionReplayRejectionFact]:
        """Plan cached bootstrap DDL replay through schema DDL ServerPlan work."""
        effects = tuple(effects)
        created_tables = tuple(created_tables)
        created_indexes = tuple(created_indexes)
        known_tables = tuple(known_tables)
        del known_tables
        return self.replay_cached_schema_ddl_effects_lazy(

    @pure_lazy
    def replay_cached_schema_ddl_effects_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        effects: Sequence[CachedDdlEffect],
        *,
        created_tables: Sequence[SqlTableName],
        created_indexes: Sequence[SqlIndexName] = (),
        source: SchemaDdlReplaySource,
        produced_ref: ServerPlanRefId | Unset = UNSET,
        replay_hash: BootstrapFactsHash | Unset = UNSET,
    ) -> LazyResult[BootstrapTransitionReplayFact | BootstrapTransitionReplayRejectionFact]:
        """Plan cached DDL replay behind any pending schema effects."""
        effects = tuple(effects)
        created_tables = tuple(created_tables)
        created_indexes = tuple(created_indexes)
        existing_tables = tuple(str(table_name) for table_name in self._schema_operation_plan.existing_tables)
        projected_created_tables = tuple(table_name for table_name in created_tables if table_name in existing_tables)
        if not _cached_schema_replay_is_self_contained(
            tuple(effects),
            existing_tables=tuple(self._schema_operation_plan.existing_tables),
            planned_created_tables=projected_created_tables,
        ):
            _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("schema_ddl_replay_declined"), DiagnosticLabel(source))
            return _schema_static_value_lazy(
                self,
                _bootstrap_transition_replay_rejection_fact(
                    source=source,
                    source_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{source}:declined"),
                    effects=tuple(effects),
                    reason="not_self_contained",
                ),
            )

        pending_dependency_refs = list(self._schema_ddl_dependency_refs())

        dependency_refs = pending_dependency_refs
        for effect in effects:
            ddl_effect = self._build_ddl_effect_lazy(
                cast("SqlRenderable", cached_effect_to_renderable(effect)),
            )
            dependency_refs.extend(
                _schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(ddl_effect),
            )

        plan = self.plan()
        schema_service = self._conn._backend_schema_service
        replay_columns = schema_service.cached_schema_replay_columns(effects)
        out_ref = produced_ref if produced_ref is not UNSET else ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref())
        replay_schema_plan = self._bootstrap_replay_schema_plan(
            tuple(created_tables),
            created_indexes=tuple(created_indexes),
            effects=tuple(effects),
            source_ref=out_ref,
        )
        self._ingest_bootstrap_schema_plan(replay_schema_plan)
        plan.add_step(
            _collect_results_module().StaticValueAfterDepsStep(
                str(out_ref),
                _bootstrap_transition_replay_fact(
                    source=source,
                    source_ref=ServerPlanRefId(out_ref),
                    effects=tuple(effects),
                    replay_hash_override=replay_hash,
                ),
                dependency_refs,
                lifecycle_effects=(
                    BootstrapReplaySchemaProjectionEffect(
                        source=source,
                        schema_plan=replay_schema_plan,
                        effects=tuple(effects),
                        columns_by_table=tuple(
                            (
                                SqlTableName(table_name),
                                tuple(SqlColumnName(column_name) for column_name in columns),
                            )
                            for table_name, columns in sorted(replay_columns.items())
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
        return self.publish_schema_output_lazy(
            operation=LazyOperation(op="execute"),
            ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(out_ref),
            dependency_refs=frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in {str(out_ref), *dependency_refs}),
        )

        self._ingest_bootstrap_schema_plan(schema_plan)

    @pure_lazy
    def _bootstrap_replay_schema_plan(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        created_tables: tuple[SqlTableName, ...],
        *,
        created_indexes: tuple[SqlIndexName, ...],
        effects: tuple[CachedDdlEffect, ...],
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    ) -> BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan:
        """Decode replay records into the nominal facts consumed by the ledger."""
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_physical_contract import physical_schema_contract_for_model
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_schema_plan import (
            BootstrapSchemaColumnFact,
            BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan,
            BootstrapSchemaIndexFact,
            BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact,
        )

        created_table_set = frozenset(created_tables)
        models_by_table = {SqlTableName(table_config.plural): model_cls for model_cls, table_config in get_registered_tables().items()}
        column_facts: list[BootstrapSchemaColumnFact] = []
        index_facts: list[BootstrapSchemaIndexFact] = []
        for table_name in created_tables:
            model_cls = models_by_table.get(table_name)
            if model_cls is None:
                continue
            contract = physical_schema_contract_for_model(model_cls)
            for contract_table in contract.tables:
                fact_table_name = SqlTableName(contract_table.table_name)
                if fact_table_name not in created_table_set:
                    continue
                column_facts.extend(
                    BootstrapSchemaColumnFact(
                        table_name=fact_table_name,
                        column_name=SqlColumnName(column_name),
                        source_ref=source_ref,
                    )
                    for column_name in contract_table.required_columns
                )
                index_facts.extend(
                    BootstrapSchemaIndexFact(
                        table_name=fact_table_name,
                        index_name=SqlIndexName(index_name),
                        source_ref=source_ref,
                    )
                    for index_name in contract_table.required_indexes
                )
        declared_indexes = frozenset(created_indexes)
        for effect in effects:
            match = re.match(_CACHED_REPLAY_CREATE_INDEX_PATTERN, effect.sql.strip(), re.IGNORECASE)
            if match is None:
                continue
            index_name = SqlIndexName(_cached_replay_identifier_name(SchemaObjectName(match.group("index"))))
            if declared_indexes and index_name not in declared_indexes:
                continue
            index_facts.append(
                BootstrapSchemaIndexFact(
                    table_name=SqlTableName(_cached_replay_identifier_name(SchemaObjectName(match.group("table")))),
                    index_name=index_name,
                    source_ref=source_ref,
                ),
            )
        return BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan(
            table_family_facts=tuple(
                BootstrapSchemaTableFamilyFact(
                    primary_table=table_name,
                    family_tables=(table_name,),
                    schema_hash=SchemaFingerprintHash(
                        hashlib.sha256(str(table_name).encode()).hexdigest()[:32],
                    ),
                    source_ref=source_ref,
                )
                for table_name in created_tables
            ),
            column_facts=tuple(dict.fromkeys(column_facts)),
            index_facts=tuple(dict.fromkeys(index_facts)),
            dependency_tail_refs=(source_ref,),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        ddl_statements: tuple[SqlRenderable, ...],
        *,
        name: SchemaDdlOperationName | Unset = UNSET,
        phase: SchemaDdlPhase | DefaultSchemaDdlPhase = DefaultSchemaDdlPhase(),
        logical_source_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = (),
    ) -> LazyResult[BootstrapSchemaDdlPlan]:
        """Lower one closed bootstrap DDL bundle into the schema plan."""
        resolved_name = AnonymousSchemaDdlOperation() if name is UNSET else name
        statements = tuple(ddl_statements)
        source_refs = tuple(logical_source_refs)
        if source_refs and len(source_refs) != len(statements):
            msg = "_bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy logical_source_refs must match statement count"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if not statements:
            return _schema_plan_lazy_from_effect_refs(self, (), name=resolved_name, phase=phase)
        match phase:
            case DefaultSchemaDdlPhase():
                bundle_phase = SchemaDdlPhase("bootstrap_ddl_bundle")
            case str():
                bundle_phase = SchemaDdlPhase(phase)
        match resolved_name:
            case SchemaDdlOperationName():
                effective_name = resolved_name
                source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | Unset = ServerPlanRefId(resolved_name)
            case AnonymousSchemaDdlOperation():
                effective_name = SchemaDdlOperationName(bundle_phase)
                source_ref = UNSET
        if bundle_phase not in {
            "create_table",
            "create_table_index",
            "create_versioned_table_family",
            "reconcile_index",
            "staged_trigger",
            "staged_trigger_materialized",
            "trigger",
        } and any(
            operation.kind is SchemaOperationKind.CREATE_TABLE and operation.schema_model is not UNSET
            for operation in self._schema_operation_plan.operations
        ):
            statements, source_refs = self._dedupe_bootstrap_ddl_bundle(
                statements,
                source_refs=source_refs,
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase(bundle_phase),
                name=resolved_name,
            )
            if not statements:
                return _schema_plan_lazy_from_effect_refs(self, (), name=resolved_name, phase=SchemaDdlPhase(bundle_phase))
            self._schema_operation_plan.add_operation(
                SchemaOperation(
                    kind=SchemaOperationKind.DEFERRED_DDL_WORK_PRODUCT,
                    name=effective_name,
                    ddl_work_product=DeferredSchemaDdlWorkProduct(
                        statements=statements,
                        name=resolved_name,
                        phase=SchemaDdlPhase(bundle_phase),
                        logical_source_refs=source_refs,
                    ),
                ),
            )
            return _schema_plan_lazy_from_effect_refs(
                self,
                (),
                name=resolved_name,
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase(bundle_phase),
            )
        if bundle_phase == "staged_trigger":
            return self._defer_staged_trigger_ddl_batch(statements, name=resolved_name)
        if bundle_phase == "polymorphic_discriminator_guard":
            return self._defer_polymorphic_guard_ddl_batch(statements)
        supports_bundle = _supports_multi_statement_schema_ddl(self._conn)
        if supports_bundle:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.base import render_to_sql

            dialect = self._conn.get_dialect()
            supports_bundle = all(not render_to_sql(statement, dialect)[1] for statement in statements)
        if not supports_bundle:
            if bundle_phase != "reconcile_index":
                statements, source_refs = self._dedupe_bootstrap_ddl_bundle(
                    statements,
                    source_refs=source_refs,
                    phase=SchemaDdlPhase(bundle_phase),
                    name=resolved_name,
                )
            effect_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
            effect_dependency_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
            for statement in statements:
                effect = self._build_ddl_effect_lazy(statement)
                effect_refs.append(_bootstrap_schema_ref(effect, effective_name))
                effect_dependency_refs.extend(_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(effect))
            return _schema_plan_lazy_from_effect_refs(
                self,
                tuple(effect_refs),
                name=resolved_name,
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase(bundle_phase),
                dependency_refs=tuple(dict.fromkeys(effect_dependency_refs)),
            )
        if bundle_phase != "reconcile_index":
            statements, source_refs = self._dedupe_bootstrap_ddl_bundle(
                statements,
                source_refs=source_refs,
                phase=SchemaDdlPhase(bundle_phase),
                name=resolved_name,
            )
        for statement in statements:
            _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(
                DiagnosticLabel("bootstrap_ddl_logical_leaf"),
                DiagnosticLabel(f"{bundle_phase}:{type(statement).__name__}"),
            )
        if not statements:
            return _schema_plan_lazy_from_effect_refs(self, (), name=resolved_name, phase=SchemaDdlPhase(bundle_phase))
        effect = self._build_ddl_effect_lazy(
            cast(
                SqlRenderable,
                _bootstrap_ddl_bundle(
                    statements,
                    phase=SchemaDdlPhase(bundle_phase),
                    source_ref=source_ref,
                    logical_source_refs=source_refs,
                ),
            )
        )
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("ddl_family_enqueued"), DiagnosticLabel("bundle_many"))
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(
            DiagnosticLabel("ddl_family_enqueued_bundle_items"),
            DiagnosticLabel(effective_name),
            len(statements),
        )
        effect_ref = _bootstrap_schema_ref(effect, effective_name)
        return _schema_plan_lazy_from_effect_refs(
            self,
            (effect_ref,),
            name=resolved_name,
            phase=SchemaDdlPhase(bundle_phase),
            dependency_refs=_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(effect),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _enqueue_bootstrap_dml_statements_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        statements: tuple[tuple[SqlRenderable, SqlParamTuple], ...],
        *,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        mutation_kind: BootstrapMutationKind,
        dependency_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = (),
        dependency_table_reads: tuple[SqlTableName, ...] = (),
        produced_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = (),
        result_dependency_refs: _BootstrapPlanningSink[ServerPlanRefId] = _DISCARD_BOOTSTRAP_DEPENDENCY_REFS,
        result_plan_refs: _BootstrapPlanningSink[_BootstrapPlanRef] = _DISCARD_BOOTSTRAP_PLAN_REFS,
    ) -> BootstrapDmlEffectBatch:
        if not statements:
            return BootstrapDmlEffectBatch()
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_state import BootstrapPlanningError

        plan = self.plan()
        schema_dependency_refs = frozenset(ref_id for ref_id in self._schema_ddl_dependency_refs())
        normalized_dependency_refs = frozenset(str(ref_id) for ref_id in dependency_refs) | schema_dependency_refs
        effects: list[BootstrapDmlEffect] = []
        read_tables = frozenset({table_name, *dependency_table_reads})
        grammar_module = _grammar_execute_module()
        config_cls = grammar_module._GrammarExecuteConfig
        step_cls = grammar_module.BootstrapDmlWorkProductStep
        if produced_refs and len(produced_refs) != len(statements):
            msg = "bootstrap upsert produced_refs must match generated statement count"
            raise BootstrapPlanningError(msg)
        batch_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref())
        config = config_cls(
            reads=read_tables,
            writes=frozenset({table_name}),
            after_refs=normalized_dependency_refs,
        )
        result_labels = tuple(str(produced_refs[index]) if produced_refs else f"{table_name}:{index}" for index in range(len(statements)))
        statement_batch = SqlStatementBatch(
            tuple(stmt for stmt, _params in statements),
            category=SqlStatementBatchCategory.BOOTSTRAP_DML,
            params_per_stmt=tuple(tuple(_bootstrap_dml_param(param) for param in params) for _stmt, params in statements),
            collect_results_per_stmt=tuple(True for _statement in statements),
            result_labels_per_stmt=result_labels,
            logical_statement_count=len(statements),
            logical_source_refs=result_labels,
            logical_phase=f"bootstrap_dml:{mutation_kind}",
        )
        plan.add_step(step_cls(batch_ref_id, statement_batch, config))
        batch_ref_id = self._coalesce_latest_bootstrap_dml_step(
            batch_ref_id,
            table_name=table_name,
            mutation_kind=mutation_kind,
        )
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("bootstrap_dml_statement_batch"), DiagnosticLabel(str(table_name)))
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(
            DiagnosticLabel("bootstrap_dml_statement_batch_items"), DiagnosticLabel(str(table_name)), len(statements)
        )
        if not produced_refs:
            effect = BootstrapDmlEffect(
                produced_ref=batch_ref_id,
                dependency_refs=tuple(
                    dict.fromkeys(
                        (*tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in sorted(normalized_dependency_refs)), batch_ref_id),
                    )
                ),
            )
            effects.append(effect)
            result_dependency_refs.extend(effect.dependency_refs)
            result_plan_refs.append((effect.produced_ref, effect.dependency_refs))
            return BootstrapDmlEffectBatch(tuple(effects))
        static_step_cls = _collect_results_module().StaticValueAfterDepsStep
        for produced_ref in produced_refs:
            plan.add_step(
                static_step_cls(
                    str(produced_ref),
                    1,
                    [str(batch_ref_id)],
                ),
            )
            effect = BootstrapDmlEffect(
                produced_ref=produced_ref,
                dependency_refs=tuple(
                    dict.fromkeys(
                        (
                            *tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in sorted(normalized_dependency_refs)),
                            batch_ref_id,
                            produced_ref,
                        )
                    )
                ),
            )
            effects.append(effect)
            result_dependency_refs.extend(effect.dependency_refs)
            result_plan_refs.append((effect.produced_ref, effect.dependency_refs))
        return BootstrapDmlEffectBatch(tuple(effects))

    @pure_lazy
    def _publish_bootstrap_mutation_completion_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        *,
        mutation_kind: BootstrapMutationKind,
        mutation_ref_ids: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...],
        dependency_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = (),
    ) -> LazyResult[int]:
        plan = self.plan()

            dict.fromkeys((*tuple(str(ref_id) for ref_id in dependency_refs), *tuple(str(ref_id) for ref_id in mutation_ref_ids))),

        produced_ref = ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref())

            expected_type=int,
            dependency_refs=frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in normalized_dependency_refs) | frozenset({produced_ref}),

        return result

    def _enqueue_bootstrap_versioning_physical_key_steps_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        *,
        branch_id: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],

    ) -> BootstrapDmlEffectBatch:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.commit_branch_steps import (
            InsertBranchPhysicalKeyStep,
            InsertRevisionPhysicalKeyStep,
        )

        plan = self.plan()
        depends_on = frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in dependency_refs)
        branch_step_ref = ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref())
        root_revision_step_ref = ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref())
        revision_step_ref = ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref())
        plan.add_step(InsertBranchPhysicalKeyStep(branch_step_ref, branch_id, depends_on=depends_on))

        plan.add_step(InsertRevisionPhysicalKeyStep(revision_step_ref, revision_id, depends_on=depends_on))
        branch_result = self._publish_bootstrap_mutation_completion_lazy(
            mutation_kind=BootstrapMutationKind("versioning_physical_keys"),
            mutation_ref_ids=(branch_step_ref,),
            dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
        )
        revision_result = self._publish_bootstrap_mutation_completion_lazy(
            mutation_kind=BootstrapMutationKind("versioning_physical_keys"),
            mutation_ref_ids=(root_revision_step_ref, revision_step_ref),
            dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
        )
        branch_effect = BootstrapDmlEffect(
            produced_ref=require_published_source_ref_for_planning(branch_result, context="bootstrap branch physical key"),
            dependency_refs=_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(branch_result),
        )
        revision_effect = BootstrapDmlEffect(
            produced_ref=require_published_source_ref_for_planning(revision_result, context="bootstrap revision physical key"),
            dependency_refs=_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(revision_result),
        )
        result_plan_refs.extend(
            (
                (branch_effect.produced_ref, branch_effect.dependency_refs),
                (revision_effect.produced_ref, revision_effect.dependency_refs),
            ),
        )
        return BootstrapDmlEffectBatch((branch_effect, revision_effect))

    @pure_lazy
    def _coalesce_latest_bootstrap_dml_step(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        batch_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        mutation_kind: BootstrapMutationKind,
    ) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        """Merge adjacent compatible typed DML products without changing proof refs."""

        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_data_plan import BootstrapDataPrimitivePlan

        # Deliberately Postgres-only. This merge walks backwards past intervening steps to
        # reach the previous product, which is why it needs the dependency screen below, and
        # even then it can only merge what happens to be reachable that way. Backends without
        # data-modifying CTEs get their DML collapsed instead when the terminal closes, where
        # the children are already topologically ordered and consecutive runs can be fused
        # wholesale; see ``lower_bootstrap_terminal_work_products``.
        if not _is_postgres_backend(self._conn):
            return batch_ref_id
        plan = self.plan()
        if not plan._steps or str(plan._steps[-1].ref_id) != str(batch_ref_id):
            return batch_ref_id
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.grammar_execute import BootstrapDmlWorkProductStep

        work_product_cls = BootstrapDmlWorkProductStep
        current_step = plan._steps[-1]
        if type(current_step) is not work_product_cls:
            return batch_ref_id
        position_by_ref = {ServerPlanRefId(step.ref_id): index for index, step in enumerate(plan._steps)}
        current_dependencies = current_step.dependencies()
        for previous_index in range(len(plan._steps) - 2, -1, -1):
            previous_step = plan._steps[previous_index]
            if type(previous_step) is work_product_cls:
                previous_tables = previous_step.tables_written()
                current_tables = current_step.tables_written()
                versioned_seed_boundary = any(table.endswith(("_tip", "_sparse")) for table in previous_tables | current_tables)
                has_unsettled_dependency = _bootstrap_dml_merge_has_unsettled_dependency(
                    tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in (*current_dependencies, *previous_step.dependencies())),
                    position_by_ref=tuple(position_by_ref.items()),
                    merge_index=previous_index,
                    step_count=len(plan._steps),
                )
                if (previous_tables != current_tables and versioned_seed_boundary) or has_unsettled_dependency:
                    return batch_ref_id
                combined_step = previous_step.combine_compatible(current_step)
                if combined_step is None:
                    return batch_ref_id
                plan._steps[previous_index] = combined_step
                plan._steps.pop()
                _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("bootstrap_dml_work_product_coalesced"), DiagnosticLabel(mutation_kind))
                _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(
                    DiagnosticLabel("bootstrap_dml_work_product_coalesced_table"), DiagnosticLabel(str(table_name))
                )
                return ServerPlanRefId(str(previous_step.ref_id))
            previous_value: object = previous_step.internal_plan_state().get("_value")
            match previous_value:
                case BootstrapDataPrimitivePlan() if mutation_kind == "versioning":
                    return batch_ref_id
                case BootstrapDataPrimitivePlan(versioning_mutations=versioning_mutations) if versioning_mutations:
                    return batch_ref_id
                case _:
                    pass
            if previous_step.execution_role().value == "sql":
                return batch_ref_id
        return batch_ref_id

    @pure_lazy
    def enqueue_bootstrap_dml_statements_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        statements: Sequence[tuple[SqlRenderable, SqlParamTuple]],
        *,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        mutation_kind: BootstrapMutationKind,
        dependency_refs: Sequence[ServerPlanRefId] = (),
        dependency_table_reads: Sequence[SqlTableName] = (),
        produced_refs: Sequence[ServerPlanRefId] = (),
        result_dependency_refs: _BootstrapPlanningSink[ServerPlanRefId] = _DISCARD_BOOTSTRAP_DEPENDENCY_REFS,
        result_plan_refs: _BootstrapPlanningSink[_BootstrapPlanRef] = _DISCARD_BOOTSTRAP_PLAN_REFS,
    ) -> BootstrapDmlEffectBatch:
        """Enqueue bootstrap DML statements and return immutable effect facts."""
        statements = tuple(statements)
        dependency_refs = tuple(dependency_refs)
        dependency_table_reads = tuple(dependency_table_reads)
        produced_refs = tuple(produced_refs)
        constraint_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]] | None = None
        if str(table_name) == "sys_column_constraints":
            from l3200_metadata.constraint_metadata import ColumnConstraintMetadata

            constraint_model = ColumnConstraintMetadata
        elif str(table_name) == "sys_table_constraints":
            from l3200_metadata.constraint_metadata import TableConstraintMetadata

            constraint_model = TableConstraintMetadata
        if constraint_model is not None:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.ddl.ddl_table import SqlCreateTableStmt
            from impl.common.l3000_schema_builder.schema_builder import generate_create_table_grammar

            metadata_table_stmt = generate_create_table_grammar(
                constraint_model,
                self._conn.get_dialect(),
            )
            assert type(metadata_table_stmt) is SqlCreateTableStmt
            metadata_table_effect = self._build_ddl_effect_lazy(
                SqlCreateTableStmt(
                    object.__getattribute__(metadata_table_stmt, "_table"),
                    object.__getattribute__(metadata_table_stmt, "_columns"),
                    constraints=object.__getattribute__(metadata_table_stmt, "_constraints"),
                    if_not_exists=True,
                ),
            )
            dependency_refs = tuple(
                dict.fromkeys(
                    (
                        *dependency_refs,
                        *(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) for ref_id in sorted(metadata_table_effect.dependencies())),
                    ),
                ),
            )
        return self._enqueue_bootstrap_dml_statements_lazy(
            tuple(statements),
            table_name=table_name,
            mutation_kind=mutation_kind,
            dependency_refs=tuple(dependency_refs),
            dependency_table_reads=tuple(dependency_table_reads),
            produced_refs=tuple(produced_refs),
            result_dependency_refs=result_dependency_refs,
            result_plan_refs=result_plan_refs,
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def upsert_bootstrap_rows_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        rows: Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId] | BootstrapRowMutationWorkProduct],
        *,
        conflict_fields: Sequence[DynamicFieldName],
        exclude_fields: Sequence[DynamicFieldName] = (),
        custom_update: tuple[tuple[DynamicFieldName, SqlRenderable], ...] | Unset = UNSET,
        mutation_kind: BootstrapMutationKind = BootstrapMutationKind("metadata"),
        dependency_refs: Sequence[ServerPlanRefId] = (),
        dependency_table_reads: Sequence[SqlTableName] = (),
        produced_refs: Sequence[ServerPlanRefId] = (),
        planning_values: _BootstrapPlanningSink[BootstrapDataPrimitivePlan] = _DISCARD_BOOTSTRAP_PRIMITIVE_PLANS,
    ) -> LazyResult[BootstrapDataPrimitivePlan]:
        """Enqueue idempotent bootstrap row upserts in this schema transaction."""
        rows = tuple(rows)
        conflict_fields = tuple(conflict_fields)
        exclude_fields = tuple(exclude_fields)
        dependency_refs = tuple(dependency_refs)
        dependency_table_reads = tuple(dependency_table_reads)
        produced_refs = tuple(produced_refs)
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_data_plan import (
            BootstrapDataMutationContract,
            BootstrapDataPrimitiveIdentity,
            BootstrapDataPrimitiveKind,
            BootstrapDataPrimitivePlan,
        )

        effects = self._enqueue_bootstrap_upsert_statements_lazy(
            model_cls,
            tuple(rows),
            conflict_fields=tuple(conflict_fields),
            exclude_fields=tuple(exclude_fields),
            custom_update=custom_update,
            mutation_kind=mutation_kind,
            dependency_refs=tuple(dependency_refs),
            dependency_table_reads=tuple(dependency_table_reads),
            produced_refs=tuple(produced_refs),
        )
        mutations = tuple(
            BootstrapDataMutationContract(
                identity=BootstrapDataPrimitiveIdentity(
                    primitive_kind=BootstrapDataPrimitiveKind.ENSURE_ROW,
                    model_path=_python_class_path(model_cls),
                    fact_hash=_bootstrap_fact_hash("ensure_row", get_table_name(model_cls), conflict_fields, index),
                ),
                target_table=get_table_name(model_cls),
                key_columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(field_name) for field_name in conflict_fields),
                dependency_refs=effect.dependency_refs,
                produced_ref=effect.produced_ref,
            )
            for index, effect in enumerate(effects.effects)
        )
        dependency_refs = tuple(ref_id for mutation in mutations for ref_id in mutation.dependency_refs)
        plan_value = BootstrapDataPrimitivePlan(data_mutations=mutations)
        planning_values.append(plan_value)
        return _bootstrap_data_plan_lazy(
            self,
            plan_value,
            dependency_refs=dependency_refs,
        )

    def ensure_bootstrap_immutable_row_lazy(

    @pure_lazy
