    @pure_lazy
    def _versioned_schema_reconciliation_models(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_classes: tuple[type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]], ...],
        *,
        enable_logging: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], ...]:
        """Return base and generated physical models for versioned reconciliation."""
        from impl.common.l7245_versioned_backends.registry import versioned_backend_registry
        from l7000_versioned_schema.physical_keys import BranchPhysicalKeyRow, RevisionPhysicalKeyRow

        result: list[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]] = []
        seen: set[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]] = set()

        def _append(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]) -> None:
            if model_cls in seen:
                return
            seen.add(model_cls)
            result.append(model_cls)

        backend = versioned_backend_registry.get("sparse", self)
        logged_table_cls = self._schema_backend._get_logged_table_class()
        _append(BranchPhysicalKeyRow)
        _append(RevisionPhysicalKeyRow)
        for model_cls in tuple(model_classes):
            _append(cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]", model_cls))
            for auxiliary_model in backend.get_or_create_auxiliary_models(model_cls):
                _append(cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]", auxiliary_model))
            if enable_logging and logged_table_cls is not None:
                logged_table = logged_table_cls(self._schema_backend, model_cls)
                bundle = logged_table._logged_model_bundle()
                _append(bundle.log_model)
                _append(bundle.field_delta_model)
        return tuple(result)

    @pure_lazy
    def build_versioned_schema_reconciliation_interrogation_request(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        model_classes: Sequence[type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]]],
        *,
        enable_logging: bool = True,
    ) -> "SchemaReconciliationInterrogationRequest":
        """Build a closed observation request for a versioned table family.

        A declared family rename must observe both the old and new physical
        family before pure planning selects ``rename`` or fail-closed
        ``manual reconciliation``.  The generated auxiliary models cover the
        new family; add the prior names explicitly because no model owns them.
        """
        model_classes = tuple(model_classes)
        from l1000_schema.table_registry import get_direct_table_config
        from l3250_migrations.semantic_renames import (
            get_field_renamed_from,
            versioned_table_family_rename_pairs,
        )
        from l3200_metadata.schema_state_snapshot import SchemaReconciliationInterrogationRequest

        request = self.build_schema_reconciliation_interrogation_request(
            tuple(
                self._versioned_schema_reconciliation_models(
                    tuple(model_classes),
                    enable_logging=enable_logging,
                )
            ),
        )
        table_names = list(request.table_names)
        seen_table_names = set(table_names)
        columns_by_table = dict(request.column_names_by_table)
        required_columns_by_table = dict(request.required_columns_by_table)
        for model_cls in model_classes:
            table_config = get_direct_table_config(model_cls)
            if table_config is not None and table_config.renamed_from:
                for old_name, new_name in versioned_table_family_rename_pairs(
                    self._conn.get_dialect().stored_table_name(
                        SqlTableName(table_config.renamed_from),
                    ),
                    get_table_name(model_cls),
                ):
                    required_columns_by_table[SqlTableName(old_name)] = required_columns_by_table.get(
                        SqlTableName(new_name),
                        (),
                    )
                    for table_name in (SqlTableName(old_name), SqlTableName(new_name)):
                        if table_name not in seen_table_names:
                            table_names.append(table_name)
                            seen_table_names.add(table_name)
            renamed_columns = tuple(
                SqlColumnName(renamed_from)
                for field_info in model_cls.model_fields.values()
                if (renamed_from := get_field_renamed_from(field_info)) is not None
            )
            if not renamed_columns:
                continue
            for suffix in ("_sparse", "_tip", "_staged"):
                auxiliary_table_name = SqlTableName(f"{get_table_name(model_cls)}{suffix}")
                existing_columns = columns_by_table.get(auxiliary_table_name)
                if existing_columns is not None:
                    columns_by_table[auxiliary_table_name] = tuple(
                        dict.fromkeys((*existing_columns, *renamed_columns)),
                    )
        return SchemaReconciliationInterrogationRequest(
            model_classes=request.model_classes,
            table_names=tuple(table_names),
            column_names_by_table=tuple(columns_by_table.items()),
            index_names_by_table=request.index_names_by_table,
            constraint_names_by_table=request.constraint_names_by_table,
            trigger_scan_tables=tuple(table_names),
            required_columns_by_table=tuple(required_columns_by_table.items()),
        )

    @contextmanager
    def _schema_reconciliation_snapshot_scope(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        snapshot: "SchemaStateSnapshot",
    ) -> Generator[None, None, None]:
        """Temporarily expose the closed snapshot to legacy delegates during migration."""
        previous = self._schema_reconciliation_snapshot
        self._schema_reconciliation_snapshot = snapshot
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            self._schema_reconciliation_snapshot = previous

    @pure_lazy
    def build_reconciliation_plan_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        snapshot: "SchemaStateSnapshot",
        models: Sequence[type[DatabaseObjectRow]],
    ) -> LazyResult["SchemaReconciliationFacts"]:
        """Build reconciliation facts and DDL work from a closed snapshot."""
        models = tuple(models)
        from l3200_metadata.schema_state_snapshot import (
            SchemaColumnFact,
            SchemaFactSource,
            SchemaIndexFact,
            SchemaReconciliationFacts,
            SchemaStateSnapshot,
            SchemaTableFact,
        )
        from l1000_schema.column_utils import get_db_column_name
        from l1000_schema.table_registry import get_table_config, has_table_config
        from l1050_polymorphism.type_registry import get_polymorphic_base_class
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_state import BootstrapPlanningError
        from l3200_metadata.hashing import expand_schema_contract_models

        if type(snapshot) is not SchemaStateSnapshot:
            msg = "build_reconciliation_plan_lazy() requires a decoded SchemaStateSnapshot"
            raise TypeError(msg)

        models = cast(
            "tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow], ...]",
            expand_schema_contract_models(models),
        )
        planned_table_facts: list[SchemaTableFact] = []
        planned_column_facts: list[SchemaColumnFact] = []
        planned_index_facts: list[SchemaIndexFact] = []
        ddl_dependencies: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        deferred_creation_state = self._deferred_table_creation_state
        if bool(deferred_creation_state.polymorphic_metadata_collect_inserts):
            msg = "schema reconciliation cannot nest polymorphic metadata collection"
            raise BootstrapPlanningError(msg)
        deferred_creation_state.polymorphic_metadata_insert_rows = []
        deferred_creation_state.polymorphic_metadata_collect_inserts = True

        for model_cls in models:
            table_name = SqlTableName(get_table_name(model_cls))
            table_exists = snapshot.table_exists(table_name)
            if table_exists is not True:
                if self.projected_table_exists(table_name) is not SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT:
                    create_result = self._bootstrap_table_schema_plan_lazy(
                        (model_cls,),
                        produced_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"schema-reconcile-create-table:{table_name}"),
                    )
                    ddl_dependencies.extend(_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(create_result))
                planned_table_facts.append(
                    SchemaTableFact(
                        table_name=table_name,
                        exists=True,
                        source=SchemaFactSource.PLANNED_DDL,
                    )
                )
            if is_polymorphic_class(model_cls):
                register_polymorphic_metadata = object.__getattribute__(
                    self._conn,
                    "register_polymorphic_metadata_for_schema_update_lazy",
                )
                ddl_dependencies.extend(_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(register_polymorphic_metadata(self, model_cls)))

            present_columns = snapshot.columns_for_table(table_name)
            present_column_names = {str(column) for column in present_columns}
            model_fields = cached_model_fields(model_cls)
            polymorphic_base = get_polymorphic_base_class(model_cls)
            polymorphic_base_fields = (
                cached_model_fields(polymorphic_base)
                if polymorphic_base is not None and get_table_name(polymorphic_base) == str(table_name)
                else model_fields
            )
            reconciliation_table_config = get_table_config(model_cls) if has_table_config(model_cls) else None
            source_versioned_model = (
                reconciliation_table_config.source_versioned_model if reconciliation_table_config is not None else None
            )
            if source_versioned_model is not None:
                from impl.common.l7050_versioned_schema_builder.polymorphic_field_helper import (
                    _get_table_root_class,
                )
                from impl.common.l7050_versioned_schema_builder.polymorphic_widening import (
                    collect_polymorphic_hierarchy_fields,
                )

                source_storage_root = _get_table_root_class(source_versioned_model) or source_versioned_model
                auxiliary_subtype_fields = frozenset(collect_polymorphic_hierarchy_fields(source_storage_root))
            else:
                auxiliary_subtype_fields = frozenset()
            resolved_model_hints = (
                load_connection_module(
                    ConnectionModuleName("impl.common.l3000_schema_builder.schema_builder"),
                )._get_type_hints_with_schema_context(model_cls)
                if table_exists is True
                else {}
            )
            reconcile_logger = logging.getLogger(
                "impl.common.l2200_sql_dialect.sql_schema_services",
            )
            legacy_fts_rename_by_current = {
                str(current_name): str(legacy_name) for legacy_name, current_name in _LEGACY_FTS_COLUMN_RENAMES
            }
            for column_name, field_info in model_fields.items():
                sql_column_name = SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(str(column_name))))
                sql_column_name_str = str(sql_column_name)
                column_definition = snapshot.column_definition(
                    table_name,
                    sql_column_name,
                )
                if (
                    table_exists is True
                    and column_definition is not None
                    and column_definition.data_type is not None
                    and column_definition.nullable is not None
                ):
                    check_column_compatibility = object.__getattribute__(
                        self._conn,
                        "_check_column_compatibility_lazy",
                    )
                    ddl_dependencies.extend(
                        _schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(
                            check_column_compatibility(
                                self,
                                table_name,
                                sql_column_name_str,
                                resolved_model_hints.get(
                                    column_name,
                                    field_info.annotation,
                                ),
                                SimpleNamespace(
                                    data_type=column_definition.data_type,
                                    nullable=column_definition.nullable,
                                    default_value=column_definition.default_value,
                                ),
                                reconcile_logger,
                                field_info,
                            ),
                        ),
                    )
                legacy_rename_source = legacy_fts_rename_by_current.get(sql_column_name_str)
                current_column_will_be_renamed = (
                    table_exists is True
                    and sql_column_name_str not in present_column_names
                    and legacy_rename_source is not None
                    and legacy_rename_source in present_column_names
                )
                if table_exists is not True or sql_column_name_str not in present_column_names:
                    if table_exists is True and not current_column_will_be_renamed:
                        resolved_annotation = resolved_model_hints.get(
                            column_name,
                            field_info.annotation,
                        )
                        from impl.common.l2200_sql_dialect.sql_schema_type_services import (
                            _model_field_nullable,
                        )

                        unsafe_required_column = (
                            field_info.is_required()
                            and not _model_field_nullable(field_info, resolved_annotation)
                            and not snapshot.table_is_known_empty(table_name)
                        )
                        if unsafe_required_column:
                            reconcile_logger.warning(
                                "Schema reconciliation: skipping required column %s.%s without proof of an empty table",
                                table_name,
                                sql_column_name,
                            )
                            continue
                        normalized_resolved_annotation = NoResolvedAnnotation() if resolved_annotation is None else resolved_annotation
                        if column_name not in polymorphic_base_fields or column_name in auxiliary_subtype_fields:
                            add_column_result = self.add_column_if_missing_lazy(
                                table_name,
                                sql_column_name,
                                field_info,
                                force_nullable=True,
                                resolved_annotation=normalized_resolved_annotation,
                                snapshot=snapshot,
                            )
                        else:
                            add_column_result = self.add_column_if_missing_lazy(
                                table_name,
                                sql_column_name,
                                field_info,
                                resolved_annotation=normalized_resolved_annotation,
                                snapshot=snapshot,
                            )
                        ddl_dependencies.extend(_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(add_column_result))
                    planned_column_facts.append(
                        SchemaColumnFact(
                            table_name=table_name,
                            column_name=sql_column_name,
                            exists=True,
                            source=SchemaFactSource.PLANNED_DDL,
                        )
                    )

            if has_table_config(model_cls):
                table_config = get_table_config(model_cls)
            else:
                table_config = None
            if table_config is not None:
                _schema_builder = load_connection_module(ConnectionModuleName("impl.common.l3000_schema_builder.schema_builder"))
                expected_indexes = _schema_builder.collect_sql_index_ddl_specs(model_cls, self._conn.get_dialect())
                case_insensitive_names = self._conn.backend_type == BackendType.SQLITE or self._conn.backend_type.is_mysql_family

                def _normalized_index_name(value: SqlIndexName) -> SqlIndexName:
                    normalized = value.casefold() if case_insensitive_names else value
                    return SqlIndexName(normalized)

                def _normalized_index_sql(value: GeneratedSqlExpressionText) -> GeneratedSqlExpressionText:
                    normalized = " ".join(value.strip().replace('"', "").replace("`", "").lower().split())
                    if normalized.startswith("(") and normalized.endswith(")"):
                        normalized = normalized[1:-1].strip()
                    return GeneratedSqlExpressionText(normalized)

                observed_indexes = {
                    _normalized_index_name(index_fact.index_name): index_fact
                    for index_fact in snapshot.index_facts
                    if index_fact.table_name == table_name
                    if index_fact.exists
                }
                desired_names = {_normalized_index_name(index_entry.name) for index_entry in expected_indexes}
                preserved_names = {_normalized_index_name(SqlIndexName(name)) for name in table_config.preserved_auxiliary_index_names}
                ddl_statements: list[SqlRenderable] = []
                index_entries_to_create: list[Any] = []
                for index_entry in expected_indexes:
                    sql_index_name = SqlIndexName(index_entry.name)
                    existing = observed_indexes.get(_normalized_index_name(sql_index_name))
                    expected_index_columns = tuple(SqlColumnName(column_name) for column_name in index_entry.db_columns)
                    actual_sort_orders = (
                        ()
                        if existing is None
                        else existing.column_sort_orders
                        or tuple(SqlOrderDirection("ASC") for _part in (*existing.column_names, *existing.expressions))
                    )
                    actual_prefix_lengths = (
                        ()
                        if existing is None
                        else existing.prefix_lengths
                        or tuple(SqlIndexPrefixLength(0) for _part in (*existing.column_names, *existing.expressions))
                    )
                    definition_matches = existing is not None and (
                        not existing.constraint_owned
                        and existing.column_names == expected_index_columns
                        and tuple(_normalized_index_sql(value) for value in existing.expressions)
                        == tuple(_normalized_index_sql(value) for value in index_entry.expressions)
                        and existing.unique == bool(index_entry.is_unique)
                        and existing.is_valid
                        and existing.is_ready
                        and actual_sort_orders == index_entry.column_sort_orders
                        and actual_prefix_lengths == tuple(index_entry.prefix_lengths)
                        and _normalized_index_sql(existing.where_sql or GeneratedSqlExpressionText(""))
                        == _normalized_index_sql(
                            GeneratedSqlExpressionText(index_entry.where_clause or ""),
                        )
                    )
                    needs_index_create = existing is None or not definition_matches
                    if table_exists is True and existing is not None and needs_index_create and not existing.constraint_owned:
                        ddl_statements.append(
                            SqlDropObject(
                                DropKind.INDEX,
                                SqlIndexIdent(existing.index_name),
                                if_exists=True,
                                on_table=SqlTableIdent(table_name) if self._conn.backend_type.is_mysql_family else None,
                            )
                        )
                    if table_exists is True and needs_index_create and (existing is None or not existing.constraint_owned):
                        index_entries_to_create.append(index_entry)
                    if table_exists is not True or needs_index_create:
                        planned_index_facts.append(
                            SchemaIndexFact(
                                table_name=table_name,
                                index_name=sql_index_name,
                                exists=True,
                                source=SchemaFactSource.PLANNED_DDL,
                                column_names=expected_index_columns,
                                unique=bool(index_entry.is_unique),
                                where_sql=(
                                    GeneratedSqlExpressionText(index_entry.where_clause) if index_entry.where_clause is not None else None
                                ),
                                column_sort_orders=index_entry.column_sort_orders,
                                expressions=tuple(index_entry.expressions),
                                prefix_lengths=tuple(index_entry.prefix_lengths),
                            )
                        )
                if table_exists is True:
                    for existing in snapshot.index_facts:
                        if existing.table_name != table_name:
                            continue
                        normalized_name = _normalized_index_name(existing.index_name)
                        if (
                            existing.exists
                            and normalized_name not in desired_names
                            and normalized_name not in preserved_names
                            and not existing.constraint_owned
                            and not existing.specialized_owned
                            and str(existing.index_name).upper() != "PRIMARY"
                        ):
                            ddl_statements.append(
                                SqlDropObject(
                                    DropKind.INDEX,
                                    SqlIndexIdent(existing.index_name),
                                    if_exists=True,
                                    on_table=SqlTableIdent(table_name) if self._conn.backend_type.is_mysql_family else None,
                                )
                            )
                    ddl_statements.extend(index_entry.stmt for index_entry in index_entries_to_create)
                    if ddl_statements:
                        ddl_dependencies.extend(
                            _schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(
                                self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                                    tuple(ddl_statements),
                                    name=SchemaDdlOperationName("reconcile_indexes"),
                                    phase=SchemaDdlPhase("reconcile_index"),
                                )
                            )
                        )

            if table_exists is True:
                table_config = get_table_config(model_cls)
                if table_config.primary_key is not None:
                    expected_primary_columns = tuple(
                        SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(column_name)))
                        for column_name in table_config.primary_key.columns
                    )
                    primary_constraint_exists = any(
                        constraint.constraint_type.upper() in {"PRIMARY KEY", "PRIMARY_KEY"}
                        for constraint in snapshot.constraints_for_table(table_name)
                    )
                    primary_unique_index_exists = any(
                        fact.unique is True and fact.column_names == expected_primary_columns
                        for fact in snapshot.index_facts
                        if fact.table_name == table_name and fact.exists
                    )
                    if not primary_constraint_exists and not primary_unique_index_exists:
                        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.ddl.ddl_index import SqlCreateIndexStmt
                        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.identifier_fragments import (
                            SqlColumnRef,
                            SqlIndexRef,
                            SqlTableRef,
                        )
                        from l1000_schema.schema_def import safe_index_name

                        primary_index_name = SqlIndexName(
                            safe_index_name(f"idx_{table_name}_primary_key"),
                        )
                        primary_result = self._bootstrap_ddl_bundle_plan_lazy(
                            (
                                SqlCreateIndexStmt(
                                    SqlIndexRef(primary_index_name),
                                    SqlTableRef(table_name),
                                    tuple(SqlColumnRef(column_name) for column_name in expected_primary_columns),
                                    unique=True,
                                    if_not_exists=True,
                                ),
                            ),
                            name=SchemaDdlOperationName("reconcile_missing_primary_key"),
                            phase=SchemaDdlPhase("create_table_index"),
                        )
                        ddl_dependencies.extend(_schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(primary_result))
                        planned_index_facts.append(
                            SchemaIndexFact(
                                table_name=table_name,
                                index_name=primary_index_name,
                                exists=True,
                                source=SchemaFactSource.PLANNED_DDL,
                                column_names=expected_primary_columns,
                                unique=True,
                            ),
                        )

                from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import IntrospectedSqlTypeName
                from impl.common.l3100_schema_introspector.schema_introspector import (
                    IntrospectedColumn,
                    IntrospectedTable,
                )

                introspected = IntrospectedTable(
                    name=table_name,
                    columns=tuple(
                        IntrospectedColumn(
                            name=column_name,
                            data_type=IntrospectedSqlTypeName("UNKNOWN"),
                            nullable=True,
                        )
                        for column_name in present_columns
                    ),
                )
                ddl_step_start = len(self._schema_ddl_steps())
                for legacy_name, current_name in _LEGACY_FTS_COLUMN_RENAMES:
                    if introspected.get_column(current_name) is not None:
                        continue
                    if introspected.get_column(legacy_name) is None:
                        continue
                    self._build_ddl_effect_lazy(
                        SqlAlterTable(
                            SqlTableIdent(table_name),
                            [
                                SqlAlterAction(
                                    AlterActionKind.RENAME_COLUMN,
                                    column=SqlColumnName(legacy_name),
                                    new_name=SqlColumnName(current_name),
                                ),
                            ],
                        )
                    )
                    self._record_column_renamed(
                        table_name,
                        SqlColumnName(legacy_name),
                        SqlColumnName(current_name),
                    )
                    self._conn._invalidate_column_cache(table_name)
                from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs, large_column_pointer_name

                explicit_columns = {str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))) for field_name in model_fields}
                dialect = self._conn.get_dialect()
                for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls):
                    pointer_name = large_column_pointer_name(config.column)
                    if pointer_name in explicit_columns or introspected.get_column(pointer_name) is not None:
                        continue
                    self._build_ddl_effect_lazy(
                        SqlAlterTable(
                            SqlTableIdent(table_name),
                            [
                                SqlAlterAction(
                                    AlterActionKind.ADD_COLUMN,
                                    column_def=SqlColumnDef(
                                        SqlColumnName(pointer_name),
                                        SqlTypeName("VARCHAR(70)"),
                                    ),
                                    if_not_exists=dialect.supports_if_not_exists_on_add_column(),
                                ),
                            ],
                        )
                    )
                    self._project_schema_effects(
                        SchemaOperationEffects(
                            touched_tables=frozenset({table_name}),
                            existing_tables=frozenset({table_name}),
                            columns_by_table={table_name: frozenset({SqlColumnName(pointer_name)})},
                        )
                    )
                    self._conn._invalidate_column_cache(table_name)
                self._conn._restore_removed_large_column_inline_values_lazy(self, model_cls, table_name, introspected)
                for ddl_step in self._schema_ddl_steps()[ddl_step_start:]:
                    ddl_dependencies.append(ServerPlanRefId(ddl_step.ref_id))

        deferred_creation_state.polymorphic_metadata_collect_inserts = False
        polymorphic_metadata_insert_rows = deferred_creation_state.polymorphic_metadata_insert_rows
        if type(polymorphic_metadata_insert_rows) is not list:
            msg = "schema reconciliation polymorphic metadata collection must own a row list"
            raise BootstrapPlanningError(msg)
        polymorphic_metadata_rows = tuple(polymorphic_metadata_insert_rows)
        if polymorphic_metadata_rows:
            insert_polymorphic_metadata_rows = object.__getattribute__(
                self._conn,
                "_insert_polymorphic_metadata_rows_lazy",
            )
            ddl_dependencies.extend(
                _schema_dependency_refs_for_planning(
                    insert_polymorphic_metadata_rows(
                        polymorphic_metadata_rows,
                        schema_txn=self,
                    )
                )
            )

        return _schema_static_value_lazy(
            self,
            SchemaReconciliationFacts(
                snapshot=snapshot,
                planned_table_facts=tuple(planned_table_facts),
                planned_column_facts=tuple(planned_column_facts),
                planned_index_facts=tuple(planned_index_facts),
            ),
            dependency_refs=tuple(dict.fromkeys(ddl_dependencies)),
        )

    @external_io_boundary
    def _plan_owned_tuple_result[ResultT](
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        result: LazyResult[tuple[ResultT, ...]],
    ) -> LazyResult[tuple[ResultT, ...]]:
        from l2070_batching.server_ref import inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning

        shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
            result,
            site="schema plan-owned tuple result",
        )
        if shape.symbolic_ref_id is not None:
            return result
        if shape.has_literal_value:
            literal_value = shape.literal_value
            assert literal_value is not None
            return self._publish_bootstrap_observation_tuple(literal_value)
        raise TypeError("Schema tuple result requires a plan ref or literal tuple")

    @pure_lazy
    def trigger_exists_many_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction, trigger_names: Sequence[SqlTriggerName]
    ) -> LazyResult[tuple[BootstrapIndexFact, ...]]:
        """Trigger probes are forbidden during bootstrap planning."""
        trigger_names = tuple(trigger_names)
        del trigger_names
        self._raise_bootstrap_probe_tripwire(ConnectionOperationName("trigger_exists_many_lazy()"))

    @pure_lazy
    def columns_exist_many_lazy(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        columns_by_table: Sequence[tuple[SqlTableName, tuple[SqlColumnName, ...]]],
    ) -> NoReturn:
        """Answer many column-existence checks from projected/cache schema evidence."""
        del columns_by_table
        self._raise_bootstrap_probe_tripwire(ConnectionOperationName("columns_exist_many_lazy()"))

    def _has_active_backend_transaction(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> bool:
        """Detect backend-specific transaction state not covered by the base checks."""
        conn = cast(_BackendTransactionFlagProtocol, self._conn)
        in_transaction = conn._in_transaction
        return in_transaction is True and not conn._in_data_transaction

    @pure_lazy
    def _record_schema_change(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        *table_names: SqlTableName | NoTableName,
    ) -> None:
        """Track that this transaction changed schema state."""
        self._schema_changed = True
        for table_name in table_names:
            normalized = nonempty_str(table_name)
            if normalized is not None:
                self._touched_tables.add(SqlTableName(normalized))

    @pure_lazy
    def _record_table_created(self: LazySchemaTransaction, table_name: SqlTableName) -> None:
        """Record that this schema transaction made ``table_name`` exist."""
        self._known_table_exists_after_commit[table_name] = True
        self._schema_operation_plan.record_table_created(table_name)
        if self._existing_tables_snapshot_for_schema_batch is not None:
            self._existing_tables_snapshot_for_schema_batch.add(table_name)
        self._record_schema_change(table_name)

    @pure_lazy
    def _project_table_exists_lazy(self: LazySchemaTransaction, table_name: SqlTableName) -> None:
        """Remember that ``table_name`` exists after commit without forcing a schema-change fact."""
        self._known_table_exists_after_commit[table_name] = True
        if self._existing_tables_snapshot_for_schema_batch is not None:
            self._existing_tables_snapshot_for_schema_batch.add(table_name)

    @pure_lazy
    def _record_table_dropped(self: LazySchemaTransaction, table_name: SqlTableName) -> None:
        """Record that this schema transaction made ``table_name`` absent."""
        from l2055_lazy_result.purity import bootstrap_lifecycle_effect_boundary_lazy, in_lazy_context

        if in_lazy_context():
            with bootstrap_lifecycle_effect_boundary_lazy():
                self._conn._mark_table_dropped(SqlTableName(table_name))
        else:
            self._conn._mark_table_dropped(SqlTableName(table_name))
        self._known_table_exists_after_commit[table_name] = False
        if self._existing_tables_snapshot_for_schema_batch is not None:
            self._existing_tables_snapshot_for_schema_batch.discard(table_name)
        self._schema_operation_plan.record_table_dropped(table_name)
        self._record_schema_change(table_name)

    @pure_lazy
    def _record_column_renamed(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        old_column_name: SqlColumnName,
        new_column_name: SqlColumnName,
    ) -> None:
        """Record a transaction-local column rename projection."""
        self._schema_operation_plan.record_column_renamed(
            table_name,
            old_column_name,
            new_column_name,
        )
        self._record_schema_change(table_name)

    @pure_lazy
    def _seed_table_exists_cache(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        exists: bool,
        *,
        publish_connection_cache: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        """Record a transaction-local table fact and optionally publish projected state."""
        self._known_table_exists_after_commit[table_name] = exists
        if not publish_connection_cache:
            return
        conn = self._conn
        conn._record_table_exists_result(SqlTableName(table_name), exists)
        if exists:
            conn._known_absent_schema_tables.discard(table_name)

    @pure_lazy
    def _seed_table_exists_cache_many(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        values: tuple[tuple[SqlTableName, bool], ...],
        *,
        publish_connection_cache: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        """Record known table-existence answers for a schema batch."""
        for table_name, exists in values:
            self._seed_table_exists_cache(
                SqlTableName(table_name),
                exists,
                publish_connection_cache=publish_connection_cache,
            )

    @external_io_boundary
    def _table_exists_many_for_schema_batch(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction, table_names: tuple[SqlTableName, ...]
    ) -> Mapping[SqlTableName, bool]:
        """Resolve many table names from one transaction-local schema listing."""
        if not table_names:
            return {}

        from l2055_lazy_result.purity import in_bootstrap_plan_active_context, in_lazy_context

        existing_snapshot = self._existing_tables_snapshot_for_schema_batch
        if existing_snapshot is not None:
            snapshot_answers: dict[SqlTableName, bool] = {}
            for table_name in table_names:
                projected = self.projected_table_exists(table_name)
                snapshot_answers[table_name] = (
                    projected is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
                    if projected is not SchemaFactPresence.UNKNOWN
                    else table_name in existing_snapshot
                )
            self._seed_table_exists_cache_many(tuple(snapshot_answers.items()))
            return snapshot_answers

        projected_answers: dict[SqlTableName, bool] = {}
        projected_complete = True
        for table_name in table_names:
            cached_projected = self.projected_or_cached_table_exists(SqlTableName(table_name))
            if cached_projected is SchemaFactPresence.UNKNOWN:
                projected_complete = False
                break
            projected_answers[table_name] = cached_projected is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
        if projected_complete:
            proven_snapshot = self._proven_existing_table_names_from_connection()
            if proven_snapshot is not None and type(proven_snapshot) is not NoTableSnapshot:
                snapshot = set(proven_snapshot)
                self._existing_tables_snapshot_for_schema_batch = snapshot
                frozen_snapshot = frozenset(snapshot)
                self._bulk_table_names_snapshot = frozen_snapshot
                self._last_bulk_table_names_snapshot = frozen_snapshot
                self._schema_table_names_snapshot = frozen_snapshot
            self._seed_table_exists_cache_many(
                tuple(projected_answers.items()),
                publish_connection_cache=type(proven_snapshot) is NoTableSnapshot,
            )
            return projected_answers
        if in_lazy_context():
            msg = (
                "Schema batch table absence requires complete projected state in lazy context; "
                "unknown table existence cannot be treated as absent."
            )
            raise LazyPurityError(msg)

        existing_snapshot = self._existing_tables_snapshot_for_schema_batch
        if existing_snapshot is None:
            bulk_snapshot = self._bulk_physical_table_names()
            if bulk_snapshot is None or type(bulk_snapshot) is NoTableSnapshot:
                proven_snapshot = self._proven_existing_table_names_from_connection()
                if proven_snapshot is not None and type(proven_snapshot) is not NoTableSnapshot:
                    existing_snapshot = set(proven_snapshot)
                elif in_lazy_context() or in_bootstrap_plan_active_context():
                    msg = (
                        "Schema batch table absence requires an observed initial schema snapshot "
                        "or a computed eventual-state projection; unknown table existence cannot "
                        "be treated as absent."
                    )
                    raise LazyPurityError(msg)
                else:
                    msg = (
                        "Schema batch table absence requires an observed initial schema snapshot "
                        "or a computed eventual-state projection; unknown table existence cannot "
                        "be treated as absent."
                    )
                    raise LazyPurityError(msg)
            else:
                existing_snapshot = set(bulk_snapshot)
            self._existing_tables_snapshot_for_schema_batch = existing_snapshot
            frozen_snapshot = frozenset(existing_snapshot)
            self._bulk_table_names_snapshot = frozen_snapshot
            self._last_bulk_table_names_snapshot = frozen_snapshot
            self._schema_table_names_snapshot = frozen_snapshot

        result: dict[SqlTableName, bool] = {}
        for table_name in table_names:
            result[table_name] = table_name in existing_snapshot
        self._seed_table_exists_cache_many(tuple(result.items()))

    def _run_post_commit_schema_write[T](
        self: LazySchemaTransaction[ConnT],
        fn: Callable[[WriteTransaction], T],
    ) -> T:
        """Run post-commit maintenance writes as an explicit write plan."""
        from l2000_connection.connection_plan_workflows import (
            SyncWritePlanWorkflow,
            execute_write_plan_workflow,
        )

        def _build(txn: WriteTransaction) -> T:
            result = fn(txn)
            if result is txn:
                msg = "Post-commit callback must not return the transaction object"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            return result

        with bootstrap_schema_write_boundary_lazy():
            return execute_write_plan_workflow(
                cast("SyncDatabaseConnection", self._conn),
                SyncWritePlanWorkflow(
                    session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                    build=lambda txn: _build(txn),
                    result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("post_commit_result"),
                ),
            )

    async def _run_post_commit_schema_write_async[T](
        self: LazySchemaTransaction[ConnT],
        fn: Callable[[AsyncWriteTransaction], Awaitable[T]],
    ) -> T:
        """Async variant of :meth:`_run_post_commit_schema_write`."""
        from l2000_connection.connection_plan_workflows import (
            AsyncWritePlanWorkflow,
            execute_write_plan_workflow_async,
        )

        holder: dict[str, T] = {}

        async def _run_and_store(txn: AsyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
            result = await fn(txn)
            if result is txn:
                msg = "Post-commit callback must not return the transaction object"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            holder["result"] = result

        await execute_write_plan_workflow_async(
            cast("AsyncDatabaseConnection", self._conn),
            AsyncWritePlanWorkflow[None](
                session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                build=lambda txn: _run_and_store(txn),
                result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("post_commit_result"),
            ),
        )
        return holder["result"]

    @external_io_boundary
    def _bump_schema_generation_tags(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> SchemaGenerationBumps:
        """Persist post-commit schema-generation bumps via the normal write API."""
        if not self._schema_changed or not self._cache_generations_table_exists():
            return SchemaGenerationBumps()
        if self._precomputed_schema_generation_bumps is not None:
            return self._precomputed_schema_generation_bumps

        tags = self._schema_generation_tags()
        atomic_connection = self._conn
        if supports_sync_atomic_generation(atomic_connection):
            atomic_bumps = atomic_connection._bump_schema_generation_tags_atomic(tags, datetime.now(UTC))
            return SchemaGenerationBumps.from_atomic_receipt(tags, SchemaGenerationRows(tuple(atomic_bumps.items())))

        def _bump(txn: WriteTransaction) -> SchemaGenerationBumps:
            bumped: dict[SchemaGenerationTag, int] = {}
            now = datetime.now(UTC)

            for tag in tags:
                new_generation = txn._execute_generation_bump(tag, now)
                bumped[tag] = new_generation

            return SchemaGenerationBumps(tuple(bumped.items()))

        with disable_sync_in_async_check():
            return self._run_post_commit_schema_write(_bump)

    @external_io_boundary
    async def _bump_schema_generation_tags_async(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
    ) -> SchemaGenerationBumps:
        """Async variant of :meth:`_bump_schema_generation_tags`."""
        if not self._schema_changed or not self._cache_generations_table_exists():
            return SchemaGenerationBumps()

        if self._precomputed_schema_generation_bumps is not None:
            return self._precomputed_schema_generation_bumps

        tags = self._schema_generation_tags()
        atomic_connection = cast(
            "AtomicSchemaGenerationBumpConnection | None",
            provider_or_none(self._conn, AtomicSchemaGenerationBumpConnection),
        )
        if atomic_connection is not None:
            atomic_bumps = await atomic_connection._bump_schema_generation_tags_atomic_async(
                tags,
                datetime.now(UTC),
            )
            return SchemaGenerationBumps.from_atomic_receipt(tags, SchemaGenerationRows(tuple(atomic_bumps.items())))

        from l2000_connection.connection_plan_workflows import (
            AsyncReadPlanningWorkflow,
            AsyncWritePlanningWorkflow,
            run_read_planning_workflow_async,
            run_write_planning_workflow_async,
        )

        def _read_generation_rows(
            txn: AsyncReadTransaction,
        ) -> LazyResult[Sequence[CacheGenerationRow]]:
            return txn.query_lazy(CacheGenerationRow).filter(typed_field(CacheGenerationRow.tag).is_in(tuple(list(tags)))).execute_lazy()

        rows = await run_read_planning_workflow_async(
            cast("AsyncDatabaseConnection", self._conn),
            AsyncReadPlanningWorkflow[Sequence[CacheGenerationRow]](
                session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                build=_read_generation_rows,
                result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("schema_generation_rows"),
            ),
        )

        existing_by_tag = {SchemaGenerationTag(row.tag): row for row in rows}

        def _write_bumps(txn: AsyncWriteTransaction) -> SchemaGenerationBumps:
            return _enqueue_schema_generation_bumps(
                txn,
                tags=tuple(tags),
                existing_by_tag=tuple(existing_by_tag.items()),
                now=datetime.now(UTC),
            )

        return await run_write_planning_workflow_async(
            cast("AsyncDatabaseConnection", self._conn),
            AsyncWritePlanningWorkflow[SchemaGenerationBumps](
                session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                build=_write_bumps,
                result_name=PlanScopeReturnName("schema_generation_bumps"),
            ),
        )

    def _apply_schema_generation_bumps_locally(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        generations: SchemaGenerationBumps,
    ) -> None:
        """Apply committed schema-generation bumps to local cache state."""
        if not generations:
            return

        generic_generations = {str(tag): generation for tag, generation in generations.items()}
        manager = get_cache_manager()
        manager.apply_generation_bumps_locally(generic_generations)

        broadcaster = manager.broadcaster
        if broadcaster is not None:
            broadcaster.enqueue(generic_generations)

    @external_io_boundary
    def _prepare_post_commit_schema_invalidation(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
    ) -> tuple[SqlTableName, ...] | NoTableSnapshot:
        """Return refresh targets when schema invalidation work is required."""
        if not self._schema_changed:
            return NoTableSnapshot()

        tables_to_refresh = self._table_exists_cache_refresh_targets()
        conn = self._conn
        conn._planning_catalog_snapshot = None
        conn._planning_catalog_snapshot_key = None
        conn._planning_catalog_model_overlay = None
        conn._planning_catalog_model_overlay_base_id = None
        conn._invalidate_authoritative_template_index_cache()
        for table_name in tables_to_refresh:
            conn.invalidate_table_exists_cache(SqlTableName(table_name))
        return tables_to_refresh

    @external_io_boundary
    def _run_post_commit_schema_invalidation_sync(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> None:
        """Execute the synchronous post-commit invalidation flow."""
        tables_to_refresh = self._prepare_post_commit_schema_invalidation()
        if type(tables_to_refresh) is NoTableSnapshot:
            return

        self._invalidate_column_cache_entries(tuple(SqlTableName(table_name) for table_name in sorted(self._touched_tables)))
        self._publish_bootstrap_column_proofs()
        self._apply_schema_generation_bumps_locally(self._bump_schema_generation_tags())
        self._refresh_table_exists_cache_entries(tuple(SqlTableName(item) for item in tables_to_refresh))
        # Native receipts were committed with the schema. Only the fallback
        # maintenance path can open another transaction here.
        if self._precomputed_schema_generation_bumps is None:
            self._conn._commit()

    @external_io_boundary
    async def _run_post_commit_schema_invalidation_async_impl(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> None:
        """Execute the asynchronous post-commit invalidation flow."""
        with _bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("schema_transaction.post_commit.prepare")):
            tables_to_refresh = self._prepare_post_commit_schema_invalidation()
        if type(tables_to_refresh) is NoTableSnapshot:
            return

        with _bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("schema_transaction.post_commit.invalidate_columns")):
            self._invalidate_column_cache_entries(tuple(SqlTableName(table_name) for table_name in sorted(self._touched_tables)))
            self._publish_bootstrap_column_proofs()
        with _bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("schema_transaction.post_commit.bump_schema_generation")):
            generations = await self._bump_schema_generation_tags_async()
        with _bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("schema_transaction.post_commit.apply_generation")):
            self._apply_schema_generation_bumps_locally(generations)
        with _bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("schema_transaction.post_commit.refresh_table_exists")):
            self._refresh_table_exists_cache_entries(tuple(SqlTableName(str(item)) for item in tables_to_refresh))
        # Close fallback maintenance, but do not recommit a native receipt.
        if self._precomputed_schema_generation_bumps is None:
            with _bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("schema_transaction.post_commit.final_commit")):
                await self._conn._commit_async()

    @external_io_boundary
    def _table_exists_cache_refresh_targets(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> tuple[SqlTableName, ...]:
        """Return table names whose existence changed during this DDL commit.

        The full cache is invalidated before refresh, so untouched tables can be
        reloaded lazily if callers ask for them again. Eagerly re-querying every
        previously known table makes schema-heavy Postgres tests spend most of
        their time rebuilding a cache that may never be read.
        """
        refresh_targets: list[SqlTableName] = []
        for table_name in sorted(self._touched_tables):
            known_exists = self._known_table_exists_after_commit.get(table_name)
            if known_exists is None:
                refresh_targets.append(table_name)
                continue
            self._seed_table_exists_cache(SqlTableName(table_name), known_exists)
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(
            DiagnosticLabel("bootstrap_post_commit_table_exists"),
            DiagnosticLabel("proven"),
            len(self._touched_tables) - len(refresh_targets),
        )
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(
            DiagnosticLabel("bootstrap_post_commit_table_exists"),
            DiagnosticLabel("refresh_required"),
            len(refresh_targets),
        )
        return tuple(refresh_targets)

    @external_io_boundary
    def _refresh_table_exists_cache_entry_from_snapshot(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        snapshot: frozenset[SqlTableName] | NoTableSnapshot,
    ) -> bool:
        """Record a known table-exists answer from schema projection or a snapshot."""
        projected = self.projected_table_exists(table_name)
        exists = None if projected is SchemaFactPresence.UNKNOWN else projected is SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
        if exists is None and type(snapshot) is not NoTableSnapshot:
            exists = table_name in snapshot
        if exists is None:
            return False

        if exists:
            self._conn._mark_table_created(SqlTableName(table_name))
        else:
            self._conn._record_table_exists_result(SqlTableName(table_name), exists)
        return True

        """Refresh cached table-exists answers after invalidating the cache."""
        snapshot = self._bulk_table_names_snapshot or self._last_bulk_table_names_snapshot or NoTableSnapshot()
        for table_name in table_names:
            if self._refresh_table_exists_cache_entry_from_snapshot(table_name, snapshot):

    @pure_lazy
    def _publish_bootstrap_column_proofs(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> None:
        """Publish committed schema-plan column facts for bootstrap proof checks."""
        columns_by_table = self._schema_operation_plan.columns_by_table
        if not columns_by_table:
            return
        proof_cache = ensure_runtime_cache(self._conn, DynamicFieldName("_bootstrap_column_proof_cache"))
        for table_name, columns in columns_by_table.items():
            existing_columns = proof_cache.get(table_name)
            merged = set(frozenset_sql_column_snapshot(existing_columns))
            merged.update(SqlColumnName(column_name) for column_name in columns)
            proof_cache[table_name] = frozenset(merged)

    @external_io_boundary
    def _prepare_schema_enter_common(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        *,
        operation: ConnectionOperationName,
    ) -> _LazySchemaTransactionConnProtocol:
        """Run mode-independent validation before DDL-lockdown checks."""
        if self._entered or self._exited:
            msg = "Schema transaction context manager can only be entered once"
            raise db_exc.ProgrammingError(msg)

        conn = self._conn

        conn._check_thread_safety()
        conn._check_not_read_only(operation)
        assert_bootstrap_transaction_creation_allowed(operation=operation, transaction_kind="schema")

        if conn._in_schema_transaction:
            msg = "Nested schema transactions are not supported"
            raise db_exc.ProgrammingError(msg)

        conn._check_not_in_data_transaction()

        if self._has_active_backend_transaction():
            msg = (
                "Schema transactions cannot be nested with data transactions. "
                "Exit the data transaction before starting a schema transaction."
            )
            raise db_exc.ProgrammingError(msg)

        return conn

    @external_io_boundary
    def _finalize_exit(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        exception_state: SchemaExitExceptionState,
        *,
        mode_label: DiagnosticLabel,
        cleanup_label: DiagnosticLabel,
        commit: Callable[[], None],
        rollback: Callable[[], None],
    ) -> tuple[bool, tuple[Exception, ...]]:
        """Run the shared commit/rollback and state-reset logic."""
        if not self._entered:
            return False, ()

        conn = self._conn
        committed = False
        primary_errors: list[BaseException] = []
        exc_type = exception_state.exception_type
        exc_val = exception_state.exception_value

        try:
            if type(exc_type) is NoExceptionType:
                logger.debug("[LazySchemaTransaction] Committing schema transaction (%s)", mode_label)
                commit()
                logger.debug(
                    "[LazySchemaTransaction] Schema transaction committed successfully (%s)",
                    mode_label,
                )
                committed = True
            else:
                logger.warning(
                    "[LazySchemaTransaction] Exception in schema transaction, attempting rollback (%s): %s: %s",
                    mode_label,
                    exception_state.type_name(),
                    exc_val,
                )
                rollback()
        except Exception as exc:
            match exc_val:
                case BaseException() as original_error if type(exc_type) is not NoExceptionType:
                    primary_errors.extend([original_error, exc])
                case _:
                    primary_errors.append(exc)
                    try:
                        rollback()
                    except Exception as rollback_exc:
                        primary_errors.append(rollback_exc)
        finally:
            cleanup_errors: list[Exception] = []
            conn._in_schema_transaction = False
            conn._current_schema_transaction_session_id = None
            conn._current_schema_transaction = None
            self._entered = False
            self._exited = True
            self._end_schema_transaction()
            logger.debug(
                "[LazySchemaTransaction] Schema transaction context exited (%s)",
                mode_label,
            )

            if committed and not primary_errors:
                raw_postgres_scope_drainer = provider_or_none(conn, PostgresBootstrapScopeMarkDrainer)
                if raw_postgres_scope_drainer is not None:
                    postgres_scope_drainer = cast(
                        PostgresBootstrapScopeMarkDrainer,
                        raw_postgres_scope_drainer,
                    )
                    try:
                        postgres_scope_drainer._drain_postgres_bootstrap_scope_marks(self)
                    except Exception as exc:
                        primary_errors.append(exc)

        if primary_errors:
            self._raise_primary_exit_errors(
                cleanup_label=cleanup_label,
                primary_errors=tuple(primary_errors),
                cleanup_errors=tuple(cleanup_errors),
            )
        return committed, tuple(cleanup_errors)

    @staticmethod
    def _raise_primary_exit_errors(
        *,
        cleanup_label: DiagnosticLabel,
        primary_errors: tuple[BaseException, ...],
        cleanup_errors: tuple[Exception, ...],
    ) -> NoReturn:
        """Raise primary exit failures while preserving the original triggering error."""
        if len(primary_errors) == 1 and not cleanup_errors:
            raise primary_errors[0]

        grouped_errors = (*primary_errors, *cleanup_errors)
        first_error = primary_errors[0]
        if all(Exception in type(error).__mro__ for error in grouped_errors):
            raise ExceptionGroup(
                f"Schema transaction {cleanup_label} raised primary and cleanup errors",
                cast("list[Exception]", grouped_errors),
            ) from first_error
        raise BaseExceptionGroup(
            f"Schema transaction {cleanup_label} raised primary and cleanup errors",
            grouped_errors,
        ) from first_error

    @staticmethod
    def _raise_deferred_exit_errors(
        *,
        cleanup_label: DiagnosticLabel,
        cleanup_errors: tuple[Exception, ...],
        post_commit_error: Exception | Unset = UNSET,
        original_error: BaseException | Unset = UNSET,
    ) -> None:
        """Raise deferred cleanup/post-commit failures after post-commit work runs."""
        deferred_errors: list[BaseException] = []
        if original_error is not UNSET:
            deferred_errors.append(original_error)
        if post_commit_error is not UNSET:
            deferred_errors.append(post_commit_error)
        deferred_errors.extend(cleanup_errors)

        if original_error is not UNSET:
            if len(deferred_errors) == 1:
                return
            deferred_error_tuple = tuple(deferred_errors)
            if all_exception_instances(deferred_error_tuple):
                raise ExceptionGroup(
                    f"Schema transaction {cleanup_label} raised original and deferred exit errors",
                    deferred_error_tuple,
                ) from original_error
            raise BaseExceptionGroup(
                f"Schema transaction {cleanup_label} raised original and deferred exit errors",
                deferred_error_tuple,
            ) from original_error

        if post_commit_error is not UNSET:
            if cleanup_errors:
                raise ExceptionGroup(
                    f"Schema transaction {cleanup_label} raised post-commit and cleanup errors",
                    [post_commit_error, *cleanup_errors],
                ) from post_commit_error
            raise post_commit_error
        if len(cleanup_errors) == 1:
            raise cleanup_errors[0]
        if cleanup_errors:
            raise ExceptionGroup(
                f"Schema transaction {cleanup_label} cleanup raised additional errors",
                cleanup_errors,
            )

    @external_io_boundary
    def _run_post_commit_steps(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        *,
        invalidate: Callable[[], None],
    ) -> None:
        """Run post-commit cache maintenance that does not perform metadata writes."""
        post_commit_errors: list[Exception] = []

        with bootstrap_schema_write_boundary_lazy():
            try:
                invalidate()
            except Exception as exc:
                exc.add_note("LazySchemaTransaction post-commit invalidation failed")
                post_commit_errors.append(exc)

            try:
                self._reseed_known_table_exists_after_commit()
            except Exception as exc:
                exc.add_note("LazySchemaTransaction final table-exists cache reseed failed")
                post_commit_errors.append(exc)

        if len(post_commit_errors) == 1:
            raise post_commit_errors[0]
        if post_commit_errors:
            raise ExceptionGroup(
                "Schema transaction post-commit steps raised multiple errors",
                post_commit_errors,
            )

    @external_io_boundary
    async def _run_post_commit_steps_async(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        *,
        invalidate: Callable[[], Awaitable[None]],
    ) -> None:
        """Async variant of :meth:`_run_post_commit_steps`."""
        post_commit_errors: list[Exception] = []

        with bootstrap_schema_write_boundary_lazy():
            try:
                await invalidate()
            except Exception as exc:
                exc.add_note("LazySchemaTransaction async post-commit invalidation failed")
                post_commit_errors.append(exc)

            try:
                with _bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("schema_transaction.post_commit.reseed_table_exists")):
                    self._reseed_known_table_exists_after_commit()
            except Exception as exc:
                exc.add_note("LazySchemaTransaction async final table-exists cache reseed failed")
                post_commit_errors.append(exc)

        if len(post_commit_errors) == 1:
            raise post_commit_errors[0]
        if post_commit_errors:
            raise ExceptionGroup(
                "Schema transaction async post-commit steps raised multiple errors",
                post_commit_errors,
            )

    @external_io_boundary
    def _reseed_known_table_exists_after_commit(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> None:
        """Republish authoritative create/drop facts after post-commit maintenance writes."""
        conn = self._conn
        committed_facts = tuple(sorted(self._known_table_exists_after_commit.items()))
        if committed_facts:
            committed_tables = tuple(SqlTableName(str(table_name)) for table_name, _exists in committed_facts)
            with _bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("schema_transaction.post_commit.reseed.invalidate_proofs")):
                conn.clear_bootstrap_scope_proof()
                conn.invalidate_bootstrap_scope_verification(table_names=committed_tables)
        with _bootstrap_profile_span(SchemaDdlPhase("schema_transaction.post_commit.reseed.publish_facts")):
            conn._record_table_exists_results(
                tuple((SqlTableName(str(table_name)), exists) for table_name, exists in committed_facts),
            )
        for table_name, exists in committed_facts:
            if exists:
                conn._known_absent_schema_tables.discard(SqlTableName(table_name))
            else:
                conn._known_absent_schema_tables.add(SqlTableName(table_name))
        authoritative_tables = conn._authoritative_template_existing_tables
        if type(authoritative_tables) is frozenset:
            # SQLite template facts are the connection's initial authority, not a
            # permanently frozen schema.  A successful additive schema transaction
            # must extend that authority before another manifest attachment replaces
            # the ordinary table-existence cache.  Apply this only after commit so a
            # rolled-back DDL plan can never become a positive planning fact.
            updated_tables = set(authoritative_tables)
            for table_name, exists in self._known_table_exists_after_commit.items():
                if exists:
                    updated_tables.add(table_name)
                else:
                    updated_tables.discard(table_name)
            conn._authoritative_template_existing_tables = frozenset(updated_tables)
        authoritative_columns = conn._authoritative_template_column_cache
        if type(authoritative_columns) is dict and self._schema_changed:
            authoritative_columns.clear()
        bootstrap_column_proofs = conn._bootstrap_column_proof_cache
        if type(bootstrap_column_proofs) is dict and self._schema_changed:
            bootstrap_column_proofs.clear()

    @external_io_boundary
    def _enter_sync(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> LazySchemaTransaction:
        """Run the synchronous schema-transaction entry flow."""
        if self._entered or self._exited:
            msg = "Schema transaction context manager can only be entered once"
            raise db_exc.ProgrammingError(msg)

        authority_context = explicit_execution_authority()
        authority_context.__enter__()
        self._explicit_authority_context = authority_context
        try:
            conn = self._prepare_to_enter()
            if not in_bootstrap_schema_write_boundary() and not _is_admin_session():
                lockdown_mode = get_lockdown_mode(
                    cast("SyncDatabaseConnection", self._conn),
                    session_id=self._session_id,
                )
                if lockdown_mode is not LockdownMode.UNLOCKED:
                    raise DDLLockdownError(lockdown_mode)
            self._activate_enter_state(conn)
            self._finish_enter_after_lockdown(log_label=DiagnosticLabel("__enter__"))
            return self
        except BaseException:
            self._exit_explicit_authority_context()
            raise

    @external_io_boundary
    async def _enter_async(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> LazySchemaTransaction:
        """Reject async entry on the synchronous schema transaction type."""
        msg = "Use 'async with conn.schema_transaction_async(...)' for async schema work."
        raise db_exc.ProgrammingError(msg)

    @external_io_boundary
    def _exit_sync(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        exception_state: SchemaExitExceptionState,
    ) -> None:
        """Run the synchronous schema-transaction exit flow."""
        try:
            committed, cleanup_errors = self._finalize_exit(
                exception_state,
                mode_label=DiagnosticLabel("sync"),
                cleanup_label=DiagnosticLabel("cleanup"),
                commit=self._commit_schema_transaction,
                rollback=self._rollback_schema_transaction,
            )
            post_commit_error: Exception | None = None
            if committed:
                try:
                    self._run_post_commit_steps(
                        invalidate=self._post_commit_schema_invalidation,
                    )
                except Exception as exc:
                    post_commit_error = exc
            original_error: BaseException | Unset
            match exception_state.exception_value:
                case NoExceptionValue():
                    original_error = UNSET
                case BaseException() as concrete_error:
                    original_error = concrete_error
            self._raise_deferred_exit_errors(
                cleanup_label=DiagnosticLabel("cleanup"),
                cleanup_errors=tuple(cleanup_errors),
                post_commit_error=UNSET if post_commit_error is None else post_commit_error,
                original_error=original_error,
            )
        finally:
            self._exit_explicit_authority_context()

    def _exit_explicit_authority_context(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> None:
        authority_context = self._explicit_authority_context
        if authority_context is None:
            return
        self._explicit_authority_context = None
        authority_context.__exit__(None, None, None)

    @external_io_boundary
    async def _exit_async(
        self: LazySchemaTransaction,
        exception_state: SchemaExitExceptionState,
    ) -> None:
        """Reject async exit on the synchronous schema transaction type."""
        del exception_state
        msg = "Use 'async with conn.schema_transaction_async(...)' for async schema work."
        raise db_exc.ProgrammingError(msg)

    @pure_lazy
    def _fuse_sqlite_schema_work_products(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> None:
        """Close one SQLite schema plan into one ordered terminal transport."""
        plan = self._schema_plan
        if plan is None:
            return
        work_product_types = {"BootstrapDdlWorkProductStep", "BootstrapDmlWorkProductStep"}
        if sum(type(step).__name__ in work_product_types for step in plan._steps) < 2:
            return
        if type(plan._steps[-1]).__name__ != "StaticValueAfterDepsStep":
            return
        conn = self._conn
        if conn.backend_type is not BackendType.SQLITE:
            return
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.bootstrap_application_terminal import (
            BootstrapApplicationTerminalStep,
            BootstrapTerminalLoweringContext,
            collapse_bootstrap_terminal_static_publications,
            lower_bootstrap_terminal_work_products,
        )

        tail_ref = ServerPlanRefId(plan._steps[-1].ref_id)
        flattened_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        for step in plan._steps:
            if type(step) is BootstrapApplicationTerminalStep:
                flattened_steps.extend(step.children)
            else:
                flattened_steps.append(step)
        profile = self.backend_profile
        terminal_children = lower_bootstrap_terminal_work_products(
            collapse_bootstrap_terminal_static_publications(
                tuple(flattened_steps),
                application_tail_ref=tail_ref,
            ),
            context=BootstrapTerminalLoweringContext(
                backend_type=conn.backend_type,
                dialect=conn.get_dialect(),
                supports_data_modifying_ctes=profile.traits.supports_data_modifying_ctes,
                backend_profile=profile,
                planning_catalog=self._planning_catalog,
            ),
        )
        plan._steps[:] = [BootstrapApplicationTerminalStep(tail_ref, terminal_children)]
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("round_trip_boundary"), DiagnosticLabel("total"))
        _record_bootstrap_profile_counter(DiagnosticLabel("round_trip_boundary"), DiagnosticLabel("bootstrap_application_terminal"))

    def _publish_isolated_catalog_evolution(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> None:
        """Publish explicit schema models for unsealed or isolated connections."""
        conn = self._conn
        if conn._authoritative_planning_catalog_sealed and not conn._authoritative_planning_catalog_evolution_allowed:
            return
        catalog_models = tuple(self._schema_operation_plan.catalog_models)
        if catalog_models:
            conn.bind_planning_models(*catalog_models)

    @external_io_boundary
    def _commit_schema_transaction(self: LazySchemaTransaction) -> None:
        """Commit schema transaction on backend.

        Commits all schema changes made during this transaction. Individual schema
        methods (create_table_from_schema, etc.) do NOT commit - all commits happen
        here when the transaction exits normally.

        SQLite commits its explicitly owned transaction here. MariaDB DDL can
        commit implicitly; this call also finalizes remaining transactional writes.
        """
        if self._has_pending_schema_plan_work():
            self.freeze_schema_execution_plan()
            self.flush_schema_plan()
        if self._bootstrap_application_transaction_completed:
            self._publish_isolated_catalog_evolution()
            return
        generation_receipt: SchemaGenerationBumps | None = None
        if self._schema_changed and self._cache_generations_table_exists():
            atomic_connection = self._conn
            if supports_sync_atomic_generation(atomic_connection):
                tags = self._schema_generation_tags()
                generation_receipt = SchemaGenerationBumps.from_atomic_receipt(
                    tags,
                    SchemaGenerationRows(tuple(atomic_connection._bump_schema_generation_tags_atomic(tags, datetime.now(UTC)).items())),
                )
        self._conn._commit()
        self._precomputed_schema_generation_bumps = generation_receipt
        self._publish_isolated_catalog_evolution()
